sections.section: ZEO Books – update package, version 1.79.5 (20 November 2026)
sections.text:
This package holds **every change made so far (versions 1.1.0 to 1.79.5)**. Apply it to the code as received (1.0.0).
After deploying, the version is shown at the bottom of the main menu, under Logout: **"Version 1.79.5"**.

sections.section: ZEO Books – update package, version 1.79.5 (20 November 2026) › 1. User rights – what was wrong and what is fixed
sections.text:
Tested on a local copy with two companies, two branches and five kinds of user:

- company admin;
- HR limited to the Sharjah branch;
- HR limited to the Dubai branch;
- payroll user;
- ESS employee or manager.

| Check | Before | After |
|---|---|---|
| No login | 94 lists answered without any token (employees, salaries, payslips, loans, users) | 401 everywhere except login / OTP / password reset |
| Another company | A user of company B read all employees and payslips of company A by changing `?schema=` | 403 "You do not have access to this company." |
| Branch limits | "User branch access" was saved but never applied – Dubai HR saw all 21 employees and 42 payslips | Dubai HR sees 5 employees / 10 payslips; Sharjah HR 16 / 32 |
| ESS employee | Could read every payslip, salary, the user list and permission groups | Own records only; approvals assigned to them; team leave / attendance for managers |
| ESS writes | Could raise a request for a colleague, and approve someone else's approval | 403 "You can only raise requests for yourself."; approvals only by the approver (others get 404) |
| Branch writes | Dubai HR could move an employee to Sharjah or create records in Sharjah | 403 "You can only work with records of your own branches." |
| Master data | ESS could edit leave types and other settings through the API | Needs the add / change / delete permission of that screen |
| Company / branch picker | Every user (even without login) got all companies and branches | Only the user's companies, and only their branches |
| Main menu | Every module shown to every user | Modules without any view permission are hidden (admins see all) |

**How it works:** a new app, `AccessControl`, puts one check in front of every API.

- It is added to each view's own permission classes, an

- Company admins (superuser or company superuser) keep full access.
- HR users with a view permission see the branches set in **Settings → Branch permissions** (User branch access).

The before / after run on all 345 list APIs is in the PPT. The company admin's results are **identical** before and after.

sections.section: ZEO Books – update package, version 1.79.5 (20 November 2026) › 2. One list screen everywhere
sections.text:
`shared-ui/z-list.directive.ts` attaches itself to every data table, so each screen keeps its own buttons, forms and actions. A table can opt out with the `zPlain` attribute.

**Search**
- Type a word, then choose "Search *column* for …" (any column, or Branch / Department / Designation / Category).
- Each search becomes a removable chip.

**Filters**
- Branch, Department, Designation and Category on every list with employees. They are worked out from the employee code or name, even when the table has no such column.
- Status-like columns, with counts.
- Date periods: Today, This week, This month, Last month, This year, or a custom range.
- A custom filter: contains / does not contain / = / > / < / is set / is not set.

**Group by**
- One or two levels.
- Groups start collapsed and show a row count and totals of the number columns.
- Expand all / Collapse all.

**Sorting:** click a column title.

**Footer**
- Select all (every filtered row, not just the page).
- Shows how many rows are selected, with Export selected and Clear.
- **Rows per page 50 (default) / 100 / 500 / 1000**, remembered per screen.
- Previous / Next.

**Export**
- **Excel, CSV (UTF-8) and PDF**, of the filtered rows or only the selected rows.
- Employee lists also get Branch / Department / Designation / Category columns.

**Import**
- Download the template, in Excel (with a "How to fill" sheet) or CSV.
- Choose a file. Every row is **checked first**: duplicates in the system or in the file, unknown branch or department, required columns.
- Only valid rows are imported, through the screen's own API, so rights, workflows and numbering still apply.
- Linked columns accept the code or the name.
- Screens that already had their own bulk upload keep it, inside the same Import menu.
- Employees without HR r

sections.section: ZEO Books – update package, version 1.79.5 (20 November 2026) › 3. Duplicate records
sections.text:
`DataTools/duplicates.py` checks every save of master data.

- Matching ignores upper / lower case and extra spaces.
- Scope is per company or per branch. The same department name is allowed in a different branch.
- The message names the record and branch, for example *Department name "SALES" already exists in Adept Business Solutions FZE.* It shows on the screen's own error message and as a notice at the bottom right.
- Covered: employee code and e-mails, department / designation / category names and codes, branches, leave types, shifts, calendars, policies, salary components and structures, loan / asset / request / document types, asset serial numbers, bank account and document numbers, projects, KPIs, courses, candidates, job codes.

- **Schedule activity** – to-do, call, meeting, e-mail, upload document, approval, follow-up; due date, assignee, note. *Mark done* writes a note to the history.

- **History** – every create, change and delete, with user, time, IP and old → new values. Recorded by the server on every save (also imports and API calls).

sections.section: ZEO Books – update package, version 1.79.5 (20 November 2026) › 8. Every screen works like one app (1.7.0) › Approval hierarchy
sections.text:
Fixed:
| Where | Problem | Now |
|---|---|---|
| All modules | Anyone with access could approve a step, also their own request, or set `status` directly | Only the approver or delegate (admins too), never one's own request; status changes only through Approve / Reject |
| Leave | 2-level leave approved after level 1; reject crashed | Pending until the last level; reject works |
| Leave | Compensatory-leave steps in the leave approval list | Leave requests only |
| Loans | Common workflow ignored; no levels = instant approval | Common workflow, level by level |
| Advance salary | No escalation from level 2 on | Scheduled for every level |
| General request | Workflow not found by branch; common workflow ignored | Branch first, then common workflow |
| Payslips | Bulk approve / reject touched slips not waiting for the user | Only the user's slips |
| Escalation jobs | Wrong filters; crash when a level had no escalation days | Fixed / skipped |

Open points (not changed – decide first):
- No workflow set up → the request is approved at once without notice.
- Some modules stay pending forever when a level has no approver.
- The approval "role" is a label; the approver is always a named user.
- Leave and general requests never schedule escalation.
- Status values in mixed case (Approved / approved / APPROVED).
- Approving late-in / early-out does not change attendance or payroll.
- A payroll run has no maker-checker step.

Suggested new approval flows: overtime; attendance recheck / manual entry; shift override; employee data, bank and salary changes; salary revision; end of service / exit clearance; leave encashment; employee-initiated leave cancellation; rejoin; payroll run release; asset return; probation confirmation; contract / visa renewal.

sections.section: ZEO Books – update package, version 1.79.5 (20 November 2026) › 13. Drill-down to the root record (1.8.1)
sections.text:
Every figure in a report or on a dashboard now opens what it is made of, down to the record it was read from.

**Reports**
- **Row** (click anywhere on it, or the › at the end): opens the record the row came from – the leave request, payslip, loan, document, asset allocation, goal sheet, nomination, timesheet line … Employee rows open the **employee file** (Employee details page); a payroll run opens its **Payroll details** page.
- **Underlined numbers** open the rows behind them in another report, already filtered:
  - Headcount: Active / Male / Female → Employees; Joined / Left → Joiners and leavers (same period).
  - Departments / Designations / Categories: Employees → Employees of that department …
  - Attendance summary: Working days / Present / Absent / On leave / Weekend / Holiday → daily Attendance of that employee and period; Late requests → Late in / early out; Overtime hours → Overtime.
  - Leave balance: Taken → the approved leave requests of that type this year; Leave liability: balance → Leave balance.
  - Salary by employee: each component → that salary structure line; Gratuity: basic → Salary by employee.
  - Exits: gratuity / settlement → the end-of-service record. Appraisals: increment / new basic / bonus → the appraisal outcome. Training: course / dates / cost → the session, attended / score → the result. Assets: Held by → the employee, Since → the allocation. Timesheets: project / task → the project / task.
- **Employee name** opens the employee file.
- **Totals** above the table open the rows that make up the total (rows where that column is not zero).
- A drilled report shows a bar "Drilled down to … – n of m rows – Show all rows". Group by, filters, favourites and export work on the drilled rows.

**Record view** (`/main-sidebar/report-options/rec

sections.section: ZEO Books – update package, version 1.79.5 (20 November 2026) › 14. Ask ZEO AI – questions about the data (1.9.0)
sections.text:
A new **Ask ZEO AI** button in the top bar (an icon on phones) opens a chat panel. Users ask in plain language – *"Whose documents expire in the next 30 days?"*, *"Total net pay by department for September"*, *"Who was absent most this month?"*, *"What is my leave balance?"* – and get a short answer, a table and links that open the report rows or the records (the 1.8.1 drill-down). Follow-up questions keep the context ("and for last month?"). Arabic questions are answered in Arabic (AI mode).

**How it is kept safe**
- The AI never sees the database and never writes SQL. It can only use four tools on the server: *list the reports*, *run a report* (filter, group, add up, up to 100 rows), *open a record*, *my own data*.
- Every tool runs **as the asking user**: the same rights and branches as the report centre and the record view. A branch HR user only gets their branches; an employee (ESS) only their own data – asked about others it answers "you may not run this report".
- Only what the tools return is sent to the AI provider – never whole tables. Rows are capped at 100 per call and long texts are cut. Nothing is stored by ZEO; each question is logged (user, time, first 200 characters) in the server log.
- At most 40 questions per user per 10 minutes.
- Answers are built only from tool results; links are only accepted when they point inside the app.

**Two modes**
| Mode | When | What it answers |
|---|---|---|
| AI | `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` is set on the server | Any question the 34 reports, the record view or the user's own data can answer; combines several reports; follow-ups; English and Arabic |
| Basic | no key | One report per question, found by its words (leave, payroll, documents, loans …), the period (today, this / last / next month, this / last year), values named

**Server settings** (environment variables – not in `settings.py`):
| Variable | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` | – | Key of the company's Anthropic account (console.anthropic.com). Without it Ask ZEO AI runs in basic mode |
| `ZEO_AI_MODEL` | `claude-sonnet-5-5` | AI model to use |
| `ZEO_AI_ENABLED` | `1` | `0` hides Ask ZEO AI |
| `ZEO_AI_URL` | `https://api.anthropic.com/v1/messages` | API address (e.g. a company proxy) |

The server must be able to reach `api.anthropic.com` on port 443. Usage is billed by Anthropic to the key's account per question (a typical question makes 2–4 calls).

**Data protection:** in AI mode, the figures and names a question needs (e.g. employees with expired documents, salaries by department) are sent to Anthropic to write the answer. Check this against the company's data policy and the UAE PDPL before switching it on; use `ZEO_AI_ENABLED=0` or basic mode where it is not allowed.

**Tested here:** basic mode on the test company; AI mode end to end with a stand-in for the AI provider's API (this environment has no key) that checks every request like the real API (headers, tool definitions, message order, tool results) – 0 protocol errors; rights (ESS refused company reports, branch HR limited to their branch); links open the reports and records; phone layout.

sections.section: ZEO Books – update package, version 1.79.5 (20 November 2026) › 15. Leave module – UAE rules, employee-wise policies, encashment, planner (1.10.0)
sections.text:
The leave module was checked end to end on the test company (approval levels, opening balances for every leave type, leave taken at random, cancellation, encashment, reports, planner). What was missing or broken is fixed below.

**UAE rules built in** (Federal Decree-Law 33 of 2021, Cabinet Resolution 1 of 2022 – have your legal adviser check the settings before go-live):

| Leave | Law | Pay | How ZEO applies it |
|---|---|---|---|
| Annual | 30 days a year; nothing in the first 6 months, then 2 days a month in year one | Full | 2.5 days a month, first-year rule, notice, carry-forward limit |
| Sick | 90 days a year after probation, medical report | 15 days full, 30 half, 45 unpaid | Probation check, document required, pay slabs written to the attendance calendar |
| Maternity | 60 days (+45 days unpaid for illness after the birth) | 45 full, 15 half | Female only, per event; extension as a separate unpaid type |
| Parental | 5 working days within 6 months of the birth | Full | Working days, max 5 |
| Bereavement | 5 days spouse, 3 days family | Full | Two types, max per request |
| Study | 10 working days a year after 2 years of service | Full | 24 months' service |
| Hajj | Up to 30 days once in service | Unpaid | Once-in-service check |
| Unpaid | By agreement | Unpaid | Days marked unpaid on the calendar |

**Employee-wise leave policies** – *Leave → Setup → Leave policies (UAE)*
- A policy has one line per leave type: days a year, how earned (monthly / yearly / per event / no balance), first-year rule, calendar or working days, gender, months of service, after probation, notice days, max per request / per year / times in service, document needed, carry-forward limit, what happens above it (keep / encash / lapse), encashable and the yearly encash limit, pay slabs.

sections.section: ZEO Books – update package, version 1.79.5 (20 November 2026) › 15. Leave module – UAE rules, employee-wise policies, encashment, planner (1.10.0)
sections.text:
- Employees get the policy of their **category**; HR can give one employee another policy (*Employees* tab, which also shows the employee's balances).
- *Load UAE standard setup* adds what is missing: the UAE leave types, an approval workflow for every branch, the standard categories and two policies:

| | Office staff (default) | Labour |
|---|---|---|
| Categories | Office Staff, Management, Technical, Non-Technical | Skilled Worker, Unskilled Worker, Field / Site Staff |
| Annual leave notice | 14 days | 30 days |
| Carry forward | 15 days, the rest goes for encashment | 60 days (home leave), the rest is flagged |
| Encash per year | up to 15 days | up to 30 days |
| Casual leave | 6 working days, max 2 at a time | – |

**Checks on every leave request** (with a message the employee understands): gender, months of service, first 6 months of annual leave, probation, notice, max per request / year / service, document, overlap with another request, and balance **minus pending requests**. Example: *"Annual Leave must be requested 30 days in advance (from 06/11/2026)."*

**Balances**
- Every change to a balance is written to a **leave ledger** (opening, earned, taken, cancelled, encashed, carried forward, lapsed).
- *Monthly accrual* (preview, then credit) and *Leave year end* (preview, then close) on the policies page. Running a month twice adds nothing. The old Celery accrual skips leave types managed by a policy.
- Opening balances: `POST /leave-policy/api/openings/` or the *Start ledger from balances* button.
- On approval the pay part of sick / maternity / unpaid leave is written to the attendance calendar (full / half / unpaid), which payroll already reads – before, half-paid and unpaid sick leave was paid in full.

- **Prorate**, per policy line: *No prorate* / *Calendar days* / *Fixed days a month* (default 30, can be 26 etc.). - **Compensatory off** (accrual *Earned by work*): weekend / public-holiday work creates an allocation when the check-out arrives (before: only when the attendance was created complete); hours for a full / half day per policy line (8 h / 4 h in the UAE setup); HR allocates (rights checked – anyone could before); balance, ledger, normal leave requests; unused days lapse after *Comp off expires after (days)* (90 in the setup), oldest first. - **Sick leave pay**: 15 days full, 30 half, 45 unpaid is set on both policies; the editor shows it in words and has a one-click *UAE sick leave* button. A 90-day test gave exactly 15 / 30 / 45 on the attendance calendar; day 91 refused.
- **Hours unit hidden**: leave requests count days only, so *hours* is removed from the leave-type form and refused by the API.
- **Role-based approvers** (Leave policies → *Approvers*): who is branch HR manager, department head, company HR manager; each approval level can be a named user, reporting manager, reporting manager's manager, branch HR, department head or company HR. sections.text:
- One formula engine for checking and calculating. Fixed: `ROUND(x, 2)`, codes with digits (`OT1`), `AND / OR / NOT` in capitals, functions the writer offered but did not exist (`ABS`, `INT`, `WORKHOURS`), division by zero, formula components that use other formula components (now calculated in order; circles reported). **All of these paid 0 without a warning before.**
- Saving a component checks the formula: *Unknown name "HAR" – did you mean HRA?*. Codes must be letters / digits / _.
- Formula writer: lists come from the server with descriptions; *Check formula* shows the value for a sample employee and the values used.

Default now `monthly_gratuity_accrual`; without a table the UAE rates are used (21 days a year for 5 years, 30 after, nothing before 1 year, max 2 years' basic). Run `python manage.py check_salary_formulas --fix` once.
- Salary components could be created / changed by any logged-in user – now HR / payroll rights only.

sections.text:
- **Days by length of service** (Leave policies → a leave type → *By length of service*): steps such as *from service year 3: 26 days*, *from year 6: 30 days*, each with its own carry-forward limit (empty = the line's). Year 1 uses the line's days (the UAE first-year rule still applies). In the month of the work anniversary the employee earns part at the old and part at the new rate (yearly leave: blended over the leave year); the ledger line says so, e.g. *"next service step: 22 days a year from 01/11, 26 days a year from 16/11"*. The Employees tab and the Leave balance report show *Days a year now* and *Service year*.
- **Prorate by days worked** (Prorate = *Days worked*, monthly leave only): earned = monthly days × days worked ÷ working days of the month. Days worked from *check-ins* or the *attendance calendar*; option *paid leave counts as worked*. Joiners / leavers: out of the whole month's working days.
- Fixed: a line with the UAE first-year rule was never prorated after year 1 (leaving month gave a full month).
- With the Shift Planner, *working days* leave and pay slabs count the employee's roster (days off on the roster are not deducted).

sections.section: ZEO Books – update package, version 1.79.5 (20 November 2026) › 21. Language packs – English and Arabic (1.15.0) › 21.1 How it works
sections.text:
- **Language packs** are files in the backend: `i18n/packs/en.json`, `i18n/packs/ar.json`. The English text in the code is the key; the pack gives the translation. `python manage.py load_language_packs` loads them (safe to run again; wording changed on the Translations screen is kept unless `--force`).
- **Arabic pack:** all 9,581 texts of the screens and the server (buttons, labels, menus, messages, report captions, e-mails, payslip, letters). Written for UAE HR / payroll with one glossary (e.g. إجازة, الرواتب, مكافأة نهاية الخدمة, الهوية الإماراتية). **Have an Arabic speaker in your team review it** on the Translations screen – every term is marked "not reviewed".
- **Choosing a language:** language picker in the top bar, the self-service top bar, the login page and My profile. Each user keeps their choice; new users get the company default.
- **Right-to-left:** in Arabic the menu, module menu and top bar move to the right and every screen, dialog, list, form, dashboard, report, the self-service portal, kiosk and login page are mirrored. Numbers, codes, e-mails, IBANs and phone numbers stay readable left-to-right. Arabic screen font (Noto Sans Arabic) is bundled – no internet needed. English screens are unchanged (266 pages compared pixel by pixel).
- **No AI and no paid service** is used: the pack is a file.

sections.text: Your specification "Hospital HR & Payroll Management System – Complete Functional Workflow" was run step by step with a test company, **Al Noor Hospital LLC** (Dubai): 15 staff and a new joiner in office and clinical payroll groups, a published nurse roster, a September payroll for both groups, assets, a leave encashment and two leavers. ZEO is now three apps in one login. You switch between them in the **app launcher**, the first button of the top bar.

| App | What it holds |
|---|---|
| **HRMS** | Home, self service, My work, Organisation, Employees, Requests, Time & Attendance, Shift Planner, Leave, Payroll, Expenses, Loans & Benefits, Assets, Performance, Recruitment, Learning, HR reports, **HR settings** (document expiry alerts and the HR e-mail templates) |
| **Projects** | Dashboard, My work (my tickets, IT helpdesk, my timesheet), Support (tickets, development requests, work log approvals), Customers & AMC (customers, AMC contracts, renewals, billing), Delivery (projects, tasks, timesheets, project costing, plan templates), Reports (support / AMC / delivery reports, timesheet and project cost reports), Setup |
| **Settings** | What the whole company shares, not only HR. **Company:** company, branches, country settings, languages, states / emirates, document numbering, AI settings. **Users & rights:** users, permission groups, assign permissions, branch permissions. **E-mail:** e-mail configuration |

Calendar and My To-do appear in HRMS and in Projects.

sections.text:
- The top-bar button shows the open app (**HRMS ▾**, **Projects ▾**, **Settings ▾**). It opens a panel with:
  - **The three apps.** Each one shows a tile per module the user may open, with the current module highlighted.
  - **Search modules and pages…** It finds every page of every app by name or description ("leave" → Leave, Leave request template, Leave reports…). Enter opens the first result.
  - **Recent:** the last modules used.
- Opening a module switches the left menu to its app, and the menu heading shows the app name. Pages that every app shares (Calendar, My To-do) keep the app you are in.
- The menu shows only what the user's rights allow, so an employee without any settings right does not see the Settings app.
- Settings → home shows the cards of the whole Settings app.

sections.section: ZEO Books – update package, version 1.79.5 (20 November 2026) › 27. Three apps – HRMS, Projects and Settings – and the ZEO Projects add-on (1.20.0) › 27.2 ZEO Projects add-on 1.15.0 – merged
sections.text:
The add-on you sent (`zeo-projects-v1.15.0`) was merged as new code:
- **Backend:** the app `ZeoProjects`, with its migration `0001_initial` created and shipped. The migration depends only on migrations that ZEO ships, so it also installs on a new server.
- **Frontend:** `src/app/zeo-projects`.
- **Existing files changed:** the settings, URLs, routes and menu lines its README lists.
- **Loading:** the Projects screens and the customer portal load on first use, so the start-up of ZEO stays as fast as before.
- **New companies:** `setup_zeo` now also adds the Projects defaults and role groups to every new company.

What it contains, in short:
- **Support tickets:** SLA response and resolution clocks in working hours, escalation, AMC coverage and approval of work that is not covered, work logs with the 1-hour rule, development requests with technical / commercial / customer approval, WhatsApp and walk-in channels, and e-mail to ticket.
- **Customers and AMC contracts:** coverage, hours, billing instalments, renewals.
- **Delivery:** projects with milestones and UAT sign-off, change requests, risks, profitability. Plan templates (the default IT implementation plan has 32 tasks, 9 phases and 6 sign-offs), sub-tasks, attachments and expected / actual dates.
- **Projects dashboard and 14 reports**, with Excel / CSV / PDF export, a weekly summary e-mail, and a work history report sent to the customer.
- **Customer portal:** `/portal/login?c=<company>`. Customers can raise and follow tickets, see their contracts, projects and invoices, and approve.
- **Seven role groups.** The README of the add-on is unchanged in the package (`README-PROJECTS.md`).

Changes made while merging:
- The Projects tables, cards and portal headings now use sentence case, like the rest of ZEO since 1.19

sections.text:
Your workbook *UAE_HR_Payroll_Sample_2050_Employees_6M.xlsx* (Falcon Demo: 3 companies and 2 branches, 2,050 employees, payroll April – September 2026) was loaded into ZEO through the normal screens' APIs and the six payrolls were run for every company and branch. Every value ZEO calculated was then compared with the workbook:

| Area | Compared | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Payslips, Apr – Sep 2026 (29 values each: payable days, 6 earned allowances, 4 overtime kinds, night shift, on-call, encashment, air ticket, expenses, advance leave salary, gross, 5 deductions, GPSSA employee, total deductions, net, GPSSA employer, gratuity / leave salary / air ticket accruals) | 12,065 payslips × 29 = 349,885 values | 349,884 equal (the one left: 26.5 days paid shown as 26 – see 29.3; the amounts match) |

| WPS SIF file, September 2026, 5 establishments (EDR and SCR) | 2,040 employee records, 5 SCR lines | all equal (records, fields, employer IDs, routing codes, totals) |
| Gratuity provision at 30 September 2026 | 2,050 employees | all within AED 0.05 per line (total AED 36,253,573.80 vs 36,253,575.51) |

The proof of the test (screenshots), the step-by-step setup and monthly process guide and the comparison workbook are delivered with this package.

sections.section: ZEO Books – update package, version 1.79.5 (20 November 2026) › 29. UAE payroll test with 2,050 employees – Falcon Demo workbook (1.20.2) › 29.3 What ZEO does not calculate in this test (entered as monthly inputs)
sections.text:
- Air ticket cash in lieu, expense reimbursements, advance leave salary and its recovery, asset damage recovery and other deductions (fines) were entered as monthly input amounts, as the workbook gives them. ZEO has modules for these (air ticket allocation, Expenses, loans), but the workbook's own amounts were used so that every payslip can be compared.
- GPSSA is set up as a company formula (11 % / 12.5 % of basic + housing + transport + other allowance, on the paid days) because the workbook does not use ZEO's built-in GPSSA rule.
- Annual leave balances and final settlements were not compared (only the gratuity part).

sections.section: ZEO Books – update package, version 1.79.5 (20 November 2026) › 31. Common fixes for every app – same interface, reports, branch rights, Arabic, Ask ZEO, record panel; 3 months of data for every industry (1.22.0) › 31.1 Same interface as HRMS (point 1)
sections.text:
- **Dashboards with a period and branch bar.** CRM, Property, Maintenance, HSE and Projects homes have the HRMS period presets (today … this year, custom dates) and a **Branch** picker with the user's branches. The choice is remembered per dashboard on the device.
- **Drill-down.** Every figure opens its list with the same filter: e.g. *Won in period* opens Opportunities with status Won and the closing date in the period; *Billed in period* opens Billing records due in the period; *Closed in period* opens the closed Work orders; HSE tiles (TRIR, LTIFR, observations, inspections) open their registers. The list shows the filter as chips that can be removed.

sections.section: ZEO Books – update package, version 1.79.5 (20 November 2026) › 34. Duplicate a company (1.22.3)
sections.text: Like *Duplicate* in the Odoo database list: make a copy of a company to try something out, to train users or to start a sister company from a ready set-up.

sections.section: ZEO Books – update package, version 1.79.5 (20 November 2026) › 34. Duplicate a company (1.22.3) › 34.1 How to use it
sections.text:
- Sign in as an administrator → company list → **Duplicate** beside the company.
- Type the name of the copy (proposed: *<name> (copy)*), leave **Neutralize the copy** on for a test copy, press **Duplicate**.
- The window shows the steps: copying the data, registering the company, giving access to the users, finishing. When it is done the new company is in the list (marked with a rose bar) and **Open the copy** opens it.
- The copy shows *Copy of <original>* under its name; a neutralized copy also shows **Test copy – no e-mails**.

sections.section: ZEO Books – update package, version 1.79.5 (20 November 2026) › 34. Duplicate a company (1.22.3) › 34.2 What is copied
sections.text:
- **All the data** of the company: every table, row and number sequence of every app (employees, payroll, leave, attendance, documents, projects, CRM, property, maintenance, HSE, settings, document numbering, rights groups …). New records in the copy continue the numbering.
- **The company itself:** country, currency, industry, address, logo, WPS details, active apps, status.
- **The same users** get access to the copy (and the administrator who made it). Their rights in the copy are the same as in the original.
- Uploaded files are shared: the copy points to the same files as the original.
- The original company does not change.

sections.section: ZEO Books – update package, version 1.79.5 (20 November 2026) › 34. Duplicate a company (1.22.3) › 34.3 Neutralized copy (on by default)
sections.text:
- **No e-mail leaves ZEO** from the copy – one check for every e-mail ZEO sends (notifications, payslips, reports e-mailed on schedule, the company's own SMTP settings). The copy's e-mail settings are switched off.
- The Projects support mailbox is not read; outside AI (Ask ZEO with an API key, document reading) is off. Free / basic AI keeps working.
- Without *Neutralize* the copy is a live company and sends e-mails like the original.

sections.section: ZEO Books – update package, version 1.79.5 (20 November 2026) › 34. Duplicate a company (1.22.3) › 34.4 Rules
sections.text:
- Only administrators (superusers) see *Duplicate*; only companies the user may open can be copied.
- The name must be new (2 letters or more). If anything goes wrong, nothing is left behind: the half-made copy is removed and the window says why.
- New API: `POST /users/api/my-companies/<id>/duplicate/` `{name, neutralize}` → `{job, schema}`; `GET /users/api/my-companies/duplicate/<job>/` → state, step, company id. `GET /users/api/my-companies/` also returns `neutralized` and `copy_of`.

sections.section: ZEO Books – update package, version 1.79.5 (20 November 2026) › 35. ZEO Cloud – accounts, plans and app licences (1.23.0)
sections.text: The first part of the ZEO Cloud design (Word file *ZEO_HRMS_Cloud_Hosting_Models_8*, releases 1.23 and 1.24). Everything here is switched off unless `ZEO_CLOUD=true`; a customer's own server works exactly as before, apart from the HR / Payroll split and the faster lists.

sections.section: ZEO Books – update package, version 1.79.5 (20 November 2026) › 35. ZEO Cloud – accounts, plans and app licences (1.23.0) › 35.1 Accounts and plans
sections.text:
- An **account** is the customer (Sahra Group). It has an owner, a plan, a state (trial, active, suspended, cancelled), a renewal date and limits. Every company belongs to one account.
- Four plans (console → *Plans and prices* to change the numbers):

| Plan | Companies | Employees | Users | Storage | Where |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Standard | 1 | 50 | 5 | 10 GB | Shared cloud (schema) |
| Advance | 3 included, extra companies paid, up to 10 | 500 | 40 | 50 GB | Shared cloud |
| Premium | Unlimited | 1,500 | 100 | 200 GB | Own database (1.24.0) |
| Enterprise | Unlimited | – | – | – | Own hosting – set up by Adept, not on sign-up |

- The console can change any limit for one customer (more users, more storage) without changing the plan.
- **Limits are checked by the server:** an employee over the limit, a user over the limit, a company over the plan – each is refused with a message that names the limit. An account can also be set to *only company e-mails* (`@sahragroup.ae`): users with another e-mail cannot be added.

sections.section: ZEO Books – update package, version 1.79.5 (20 November 2026) › 35. ZEO Cloud – accounts, plans and app licences (1.23.0) › 35.2 App licences
sections.text:
- No default app. The customer chooses the apps (Payroll, Projects, CRM, Property, Maintenance, HSE); **Settings with the employee master is always there**.
- **HR is free** and comes on with any app (employees, leave, attendance, self service, expenses, documents). It cannot be switched off.
- **Payroll is its own app.** With Payroll on, the screens are the same as before (one HRMS with payroll); without it, the payroll menus, payroll reports, loans and advances are hidden and the payroll API answers *Payroll is not active*.
- A licence is per account; each company switches on only the apps it needs (Settings → Apps shows *Licensed*, *Trial until …*, *Not licensed – Request*). An app that is not licensed cannot be switched on; an expired licence makes that app read-only.

sections.section: ZEO Books – update package, version 1.79.5 (20 November 2026) › 35. ZEO Cloud – accounts, plans and app licences (1.23.0) › 35.3 Sign up (zeocloud …/signup)
sections.text:
- Four steps: company and industry → apps → owner name, e-mail and password → *Creating your company* with the steps. Then the sign-in page opens with the e-mail filled in.
- 14-day trial on Standard, Advance or Premium (Enterprise through Adept), with the chosen apps on trial. Until 1.24.0, Premium companies also run in the shared cloud. At most 5 sign-ups an hour from one address.

sections.text:

- **Security:** only company e-mails (domain), and the people with access.
- A chip in the top bar shows *Trial – 9 days left*, *Renewal in 12 days*, *Grace period – 6 days left* or *Read-only*; for the owner it opens Subscription.

sections.section: ZEO Books – update package, version 1.79.5 (20 November 2026) › 35. ZEO Cloud – accounts, plans and app licences (1.23.0) › 35.6 Renewal, grace and read-only
sections.text:
- Trial ends → suspended until paid. Renewal date passed → **15 days grace** (works normally, chip in red) → **read-only**: everything can be opened, exported and reported, nothing can be saved. Cancelled accounts are hidden from the list.
- Marking an invoice paid (console) makes the account active again until the end of the paid period and turns trial licences into normal ones.
- Reminder e-mails to the owner 30, 14, 7 and 1 days before renewal, at the start of grace and at read-only (Celery beat, 06:50).

sections.section: ZEO Books – update package, version 1.79.5 (20 November 2026) › 35. ZEO Cloud – accounts, plans and app licences (1.23.0) › 35.7 Control console (Adept only) – `/control`
sections.text:
- Opened from the company list (*Control console*) by the people added with `cloud_admin`. Others get *not allowed*.
- **Customers:** search, filter by plan, state and *renewal in 30 days*; new customer (account, owner invited by e-mail with a one-time password, optional first company).
- **Customer:** Overview (plan, limits, dates, notes), Companies (create, link an existing company, archive), Apps (licences and trial dates), Invoices (add, mark paid), History (every change and who made it). Actions: suspend, reactivate, extend, cancel.
- **Plans and prices** (limits and prices) and **Companies without an account**.
- Moving a company between shared cloud and own database is in 1.24.0; the console refuses to change *hosting* directly.

sections.section: ZEO Books – update package, version 1.79.5 (20 November 2026) › 36. Own database for Premium accounts and the Move tool (1.24.0)
sections.text: The second part of ZEO Cloud. Each Premium account gets its own PostgreSQL database; companies move between the shared cloud and an own database – one company or several, either way – with checks and a way back. Nothing changes on a customer's own server (`ZEO_CLOUD` not set).

sections.section: ZEO Books – update package, version 1.79.5 (20 November 2026) › 36. Own database for Premium accounts and the Move tool (1.24.0) › 36.1 How it works
sections.text:
- **Main database** (as today): the shared cloud – Standard and Advance companies (one schema each) – and everything shared: users, sign-in, accounts, plans, licences, the company list.
- **Own database** (`<main name>_acc<id>`): the companies of one Premium account, one schema each, on the same PostgreSQL server or another one.
- **Registry:** each company's place is in the console (`ZeoCloud_accountcompany.db_alias`, `ZeoCloud_databaseserver`). When ZEO opens a company (`?schema=`, `schema_context`, Celery jobs, reports) the connection goes to that company's database by itself – no change in any screen or report. Users, accounts and other shared rows are always read and written in the main database.
- An own database keeps a copy of the rows its company tables point to (countries, currencies and other masters, content types, the users of its companies and Adept staff). ZEO refreshes them when they change, before every move and every night.
- Passwords of other database servers are never stored: `password_env` names an environment variable; empty = the main database's password.

sections.section: ZEO Books – update package, version 1.79.5 (20 November 2026) › 36. Own database for Premium accounts and the Move tool (1.24.0) › 36.2 Plan changes (console → customer → *Change plan*)
sections.text:
- **To Premium:** the own database is made (about 3 seconds) and every company of the account moves there, one after the other.
- **From Premium to Advance / Standard:** every company moves back to the shared cloud; the empty own database is retired and removed after 7 days. The company limit of the new plan is checked first.
- Other changes (Standard ↔ Advance) move nothing. Enterprise is set up by Adept on its own servers.
- New companies of a Premium account (owner's *Create company*, console, *Duplicate*) are made in the own database.

sections.section: ZEO Books – update package, version 1.79.5 (20 November 2026) › 36. Own database for Premium accounts and the Move tool (1.24.0) › 36.3 Moving a company (console → customer → *Companies*)
sections.text:
- *Move to own database* (Premium only) or *Move to shared cloud* beside each company. Several companies: change the plan, or move them one by one.
- Steps (shown live, with a log): **closing the company** (users get *"… is being moved – try again shortly"*, the company list shows *Being moved*) → **copying users and masters** → **copying the data** (`pg_dump` / `pg_restore` of the schema) → **checking**: same tables, same row count in every table, same numbering (every sequence) → **switching** → done.
- If anything fails, nothing changes: the half-made copy is removed and the company opens where it was. The reason is in the log.
- **Old copy:** the company's data in the old place is kept 7 days under `zmv_<date>_<schema>` (not used by ZEO), then removed by the daily job.
- **Move back:** within those days, *Move back* returns the company with its current data (a new move the other way).
- Q7 Construction copy (625 tables, 17,709 rows): 22 seconds plus the wait (default 12 seconds before and after, so every server process sees the change – `ZEO_MOVE_SETTLE`).

sections.section: ZEO Books – update package, version 1.79.5 (20 November 2026) › 36. Own database for Premium accounts and the Move tool (1.24.0) › 36.5 Updates – `cloud_migrate`
sections.text: On a ZEO Cloud server, after copying a new version run `python manage.py cloud_migrate` instead of `migrate_schemas`. It migrates the main database, the shared tables of every own database, every company wherever it lives, and refreshes the copied rows. Safe to run again.

sections.section: ZEO Books – update package, version 1.79.5 (20 November 2026) › 36. Own database for Premium accounts and the Move tool (1.24.0) › 36.7 PgBouncer
sections.text: `deploy/pgbouncer.ini`: PgBouncer on port 6432 in front of PostgreSQL, every database (`* = host=127.0.0.1 port=5432`), **`pool_mode = session`** (ZEO sets the company on each connection – transaction pooling would mix companies). Point `ZEO_DB_HOST` / `ZEO_DB_PORT` at it. Opening a company in an own database opens a new connection; PgBouncer makes that cheap.

sections.section: ZEO Books – update package, version 1.79.5 (20 November 2026) › 37. ZEO mobile app for Android – check in, leave, payslips, approvals (1.25.0)
sections.text: The first ZEO app for phones. It is the ZEO frontend packaged with Capacitor 8: the same code as the web, with phone screens (`/m`) and the phone's fingerprint, notifications, GPS, camera and files. Android first; iPhone later from the same project. Build and Google Play steps: **README-MOBILE.md**.

sections.section: ZEO Books – update package, version 1.79.5 (20 November 2026) › 37. ZEO mobile app for Android – check in, leave, payslips, approvals (1.25.0) › 37.1 What the app does
sections.text:
- **First screen:** ZEO Cloud or the company's own server (address checked against `/mobile/api/info/`; servers before 1.25.0 are refused with a clear message; http only with a warning).
- **Sign in** as on the web: e-mail or employee code and password, the code by e-mail / SMS for office users, then **fingerprint / face sign-in** if the phone has it. Several companies (or several ZEO Cloud customers) → the company list, grouped by account.
- **Home:** greeting, company, a large clock to **check in / out** with one tap (location sent with the punch; selfie when the company's rule asks for it; the attendance rules, geofence and allowed methods of AttendancePlus apply – source *mobile*), leave balance, payslip, next holiday, days present, approvals waiting.
- **Attendance:** today's punches and the month (present, late, absent, hours a day).
- **Leave:** balances, request leave (half day too), my requests with their state, withdraw while pending.
- **Payslips:** year totals, every released payslip, PDF opened in a viewer or shared.
- **Approvals** (managers): leave, late in / early out, general and document requests, assets, loans, advance salary, air tickets, resignations – approve, or reject with a reason. Newer request types are listed with *Open ZEO on a computer*.
- **My requests**, **More:** profile, open full ZEO, switch company, fingerprint on / off, notifications, language, server, phones signed in (sign another phone out), sign out.
- **English and Arabic** (right to left), the same language packs as the web.

sections.section: ZEO Books – update package, version 1.79.5 (20 November 2026) › 37. ZEO mobile app for Android – check in, leave, payslips, approvals (1.25.0) › 37.2 Push notifications
sections.text:
- To the phone: every in-app notification; a new approval waiting for a manager (*"Leave to approve – Elias Fictus · Annual Leave 14/12 – 15/12"*); the decision on your request (*"Your leave request was approved"*); a released payslip (*"Your payslip for October 2026 is ready"*). In the receiver's language; no double buzz for the same event.
- Firebase Cloud Messaging (free): one Firebase project for every server; each server needs its service-account file (`ZEO_FCM_CREDENTIALS`). Without it nothing breaks – the app works without notifications and the server records *not configured* in **Push logs** (Django admin).

sections.section: ZEO Books – update package, version 1.79.5 (20 November 2026) › 37. ZEO mobile app for Android – check in, leave, payslips, approvals (1.25.0) › 37.3 Security
sections.text:
- Fingerprint sign-in: the server gives the phone an unlock key once; the phone keeps it in its keystore behind the fingerprint; the server keeps only its hash. Unlock gives a new login. 10 wrong tries an hour → password needed; 90 days without use → password needed (`ZEO_MOBILE_IDLE_DAYS`); a phone can be signed out from another phone (More) or Django admin.
- A phone can be set up for fingerprint only by a login that passed the full sign-in (the code, or no code needed) – the code check of office users cannot be skipped through the app.
- Location only with a punch, never in the background. Every call says the app version (`X-ZEO-App`).

sections.section: ZEO Books – update package, version 1.79.5 (20 November 2026) › 38. Fixes from the Falcon Demo live test (1.26.0) › 38.2 Imports and upload (steps 8, 11, 13–15, 19, 23, 26, 38, 43–44, 60)
sections.text:
**New employee import** (Employees → list → *Import employees*, both the classic and the new list):
- **Good rows are imported.** Rows with errors are listed with the row number, the employee code and the reason, and can be downloaded as a file, fixed and uploaded again. There are two options: import the good rows (the default), or import nothing if any row has an error (the old behaviour, step 14). *Check only* saves nothing.
- **Progress bar** while the server works in the background, with created / updated / not imported at the end. There is no `alert()` any more and no 7-minute wait on a frozen page (step 15). Saving is in batches with change tracking paused, and one note per import goes in the history instead of one per field.
- **More columns:** Reports To (employee code), bank, IBAN, salary card, routing code, Emirates ID, passport, visa, labour card, every salary component (column = component name or code, e.g. *Basic*, *Housing Allowance*, *HRA*), Status and Exit date (leavers). These were missing for WPS (step 38) and leave approval (step 43).
- **Forgiving headers:** case, spaces and common names are accepted (*Emp Code*, *Employee No*, *DOJ*, *Date of Joining*, …). Excel or CSV (UTF-8 with or without BOM, Windows-1252, comma / semicolon / tab), on any sheet. Dates may be dd/mm/yyyy, yyyy-mm-dd or Excel dates.
- **Nationality** is matched by name, country or common word ("India" → INDIAN, "Philippines" → FILIPINO, "UAE" → EMIRATI). Missing ones are added in the proper form. `fix_nationalities` merges the duplicates from earlier imports.
- **Template** with a *Read me* sheet: *Download the template* in the dialog.
- New endpoints under `/employee/api/emp-bulkupload/`: `import/` (POST), `import-status/?job=`, `import-errors/?job=` (CSV), `import-template/`.

**

sections.text:
A login (e-mail / user name) is shared by every company on the server, as in Odoo Online and Zoho: one person, one password, every company they work for on the company list. Before 1.26.0 *Add user* always tried to make a new login and failed with "user already exists" when the e-mail had signed up before or worked for another customer.

- **Add user with an e-mail that already has a login:** no error any more. The person is **invited** to the companies chosen in the form, with the type chosen there (staff / administrator). The message says so, and the Users screen lists the invitation under *Invitations waiting for an answer* (with Cancel).
- **The invited person** gets an e-mail and sees the invitation at the top of their company list: *Accept* adds the company to their login (same password) and it appears in the list; *Decline* closes it. Nothing is shared with the company before they accept.
- On accept, ZEO Cloud checks the inviting account's user limit and *only company e-mails* rule – the person counts as a user of that account. Groups, branches and the employee link are then set in Users as for any user.
- Only the user name taken by **another** person still gives an error ("choose another user name"). People can only invite to companies they work in.
- New endpoints: `GET /users/api/invites/` (my invitations), `GET /users/api/invites/?schema=` (sent by this company), `POST /users/api/invites/<id>/ {action: accept | decline | cancel}`. `POST /users/api/user/` answers 202 `{invited: true, detail, invites}` for an existing login.

sections.section: ZEO Books – update package, version 1.79.5 (20 November 2026) › 38. Fixes from the Falcon Demo live test (1.26.0) › 38.7 Several own databases for a Premium account – add, duplicate, move
sections.text:
Until 1.24.0 a Premium account had exactly one own database. Now (Settings → **Subscription** → *Databases* for the owner, console → customer → **Databases** for Adept):

- **Add database:** a new, empty PostgreSQL database for the account (about 3 seconds), with a name of your choice (e.g. *Group 2*, *Training*).
- **Duplicate:** a new database with a **copy of every company** of the chosen one – all data, settings and users, as *Duplicate company* does. The copies get a word added to their names (e.g. *Falcon Steel (Test)*); *Test copy* (on by default) stops e-mails from the copies. Progress per company is shown; a company that cannot be copied is listed with the reason and the others go on.
- **Make default:** new companies (Create company, console, sign-up of further companies) are made in the default database. *Create company* on the company list and in the console has a **Database** choice when the account has more than one.
- **Move** a company between the account's databases (the same checked move as in 1.24.0: copy, compare every table, row count and numbering, switch, old copy kept 7 days, Move back in the console).
- **Rename**, and **Remove** an empty database that is not the default (deleted by the daily job after 7 days).
- **No limit – each extra database is its own subscription:** the first database comes with Premium (*Included in Premium*). Every database added or duplicated after it gets a **14-day free trial** (*Trial – 9 days left*), then a yearly fee. Adept gets an e-mail (`ZEO_CLOUD_ADMIN_EMAIL`) for each new database to invoice it, and marks it paid in the console (customer → **Databases** → *Paid until*, optional own price; *Extend trial 14 days*). The price per extra database is set in console → *Plans and prices* → *Extra database / year* (sho

The release plan in *ZEO HRMS – Cloud subscription and hosting models* (section 16) calls this "1.25.0 – Phase 3: group dashboard, group reports, one approval inbox and bell, copy settings, inter-company transfer, group roles". 1.25.0 and 1.26.0 went to the mobile app and the Falcon fixes, so it is **1.27.0**.

sections.section: ZEO Books – update package, version 1.79.5 (20 November 2026) › 40. ZEO Enterprise licence and online payment (1.28.0)
sections.text: The release plan in *ZEO HRMS – Cloud subscription and hosting models* puts the Enterprise edition (the client's own servers) and online payment after the group features. **Enterprise is never self-service: the client always asks Adept, and Adept issues the licence.**

sections.section: ZEO Books – update package, version 1.79.5 (20 November 2026) › 40. ZEO Enterprise licence and online payment (1.28.0) › 40.1 How a client gets Enterprise
sections.text:
| Step | Who | Where |
|---|---|---|
| 1. Ask for Enterprise | Prospect, or the owner of a ZEO Cloud account | Sign-up page → *Enterprise – on your own servers* → form (company, name, e-mail, phone, country, employees, companies, message). Owners: Settings → Subscription → *Ask for a change* → *Enterprise (own servers)*. Adept gets an e-mail (`ZEO_CLOUD_ADMIN_EMAIL`); at most 5 requests an hour per address |
| 2. Answer, agree the price | Adept | Console → **Enterprise** → *Enterprise requests* (status New / Contacted / Licence issued / Closed) |
| 3. Install ZEO | Client / Adept | Complete install package, `ZEO_EDITION=enterprise` in `.env` |
| 4. Send the installation ID | Client administrator | Settings → **Licence** shows `ZEO-…` (made once per server; *Copy*) |
| 5. Issue the licence file | Adept | Console → Enterprise → *Issue a licence file*: client, installation ID, valid from / until, limits on companies, employees and users (empty = no limit), apps, group features → *Issue and download* gives `<client>_<date>.zeolic`. *Issue licence* on a request fills the form; *Renew* on an issued licence fills the next year |
| 6. Upload | Client administrator | Settings → Licence → *Upload licence file* – checked at once: Adept's signature, this installation, dates |

sections.section: ZEO Books – update package, version 1.79.5 (20 November 2026) › 40. ZEO Enterprise licence and online payment (1.28.0) › 40.2 The licence file
sections.text: A text file signed by Adept with **Ed25519**. ZEO checks it with Adept's public key (in `ZeoLicence/keys.py`); the private key stays on Adept's issuing server only. Changing anything in the file (a date, a limit) breaks the signature and the file is refused; a file for another installation ID is refused. Nothing is sent to Adept – the check works without internet.

sections.section: ZEO Books – update package, version 1.79.5 (20 November 2026) › 40. ZEO Enterprise licence and online payment (1.28.0) › 40.3 What the licence controls (only with `ZEO_EDITION=enterprise`)
sections.text:
| Status | When | ZEO |
|---|---|---|
| Evaluation | No file yet, first 30 days after installing (`ZEO_LICENCE_EVALUATION_DAYS`) | Everything works; banner with the days left |
| Valid | File for this server, today within its dates | Everything licensed works |
| Ending soon | 30 days or less left | Banner to everyone: ask Adept for the renewal |
| Grace | Ended less than 15 days ago (`ZEO_LICENCE_GRACE_DAYS`) | Everything works; banner with the days left |
| Ended / no licence / starts later | After the grace days, after the evaluation, or before *valid from* | **Read-only**: every screen opens, export and print work, saving is refused (423) with the message; Settings → Licence still accepts the new file |

- **Limits:** adding a company, an employee or a login beyond the licence is refused with *The ZEO licence allows {n} … – ask Adept for a new licence file*. Existing records are never touched. Settings → Licence shows use against limits.
- **Apps:** HR and Settings come with every licence; Payroll, Projects, CRM, Property, Maintenance and HSE only when in the licence (otherwise 423 *not in your licence*).
- **Group features** (section 39) only when the licence has them.
- ZEO Cloud and servers without `ZEO_EDITION` are not affected at all.

sections.section: ZEO Books – update package, version 1.79.5 (20 November 2026) › 40. ZEO Enterprise licence and online payment (1.28.0) › 40.4 ZEO Cloud invoices in Odoo, online payment
sections.text:
With the `ZEO_ODOO_*` settings, Console → account → *Invoices*:

- **Add an invoice** has *Make it in Odoo* (an empty invoice number becomes `ZEO-<account>-<nnn>`; Odoo's own number, e.g. INV/2026/00003, is shown under it). Unpaid invoices made by hand: *Send to Odoo*. *Payment page* opens Odoo's page as the owner sees it.
- ZEO creates or updates the **customer** (account name, owner e-mail, TRN; reference `ZEO-ACC-<id>`), creates and posts the **customer invoice** (one line: the invoice note or the plan, with the period and amount; product `ZEO_ODOO_PRODUCT_ID`, tax `ZEO_ODOO_TAX_ID`), and reads Odoo's **payment link** (customer portal).
- The owner sees **Pay online** next to the invoice in Settings → Subscription; the page of Odoo takes card payment with the provider set up there.
- Every hour (Celery beat, `cloud_odoo_sync`) and with *Check payment in Odoo* in the console, ZEO reads the invoice state: *paid* or *in payment* → the invoice is marked paid and the subscription renewed / the account re-opened, exactly as *Mark as paid* by hand.
- Without the Odoo settings everything works as in 1.23.0 (invoices by hand, *Mark as paid*).

sections.section: ZEO Books – update package, version 1.79.5 (20 November 2026) › 40. ZEO Enterprise licence and online payment (1.28.0) › 40.5 New endpoints
sections.text:
| Endpoint | Use |
|---|---|
| `GET /licence/api/` | Status, installation ID, licence, use against limits (server administrators) |
| `GET /licence/api/banner/` | Licence line for the banner (every user) |
| `POST /licence/api/upload/` | The `.zeolic` file (server administrators) |
| `POST /licence/api/enterprise-request/` | Enterprise request (no sign-in needed) |
| `GET|PATCH /licence/api/console/requests/[<id>/]` | Requests (Adept) |
| `GET|POST /licence/api/console/licences/`, `GET …/<id>/download/` | Issue and download licence files (Adept) |
| `POST /cloud/api/console/invoices/<id>/odoo/` `{action: push|sync}` | Send an invoice to Odoo / check its payment (Adept) |

Management commands: `zeo_licence keys --generate --out <file>`, `zeo_licence show`, `zeo_licence verify <file>`, `cloud_odoo_sync`.

**Tested** on the test server: request from the sign-up page and from an owner → console → licence issued and downloaded → uploaded on an Enterprise test server (valid); a file with one changed date refused; a file for another installation refused; ended licence → grace (works, banner) → read-only (saving 423, lists and exports work, upload still possible); CRM not in the licence → 423; licence without group features → Group view refused; employee limit reached → refused with the message. Odoo (test Odoo server): customer and invoice created, payment link shown to the owner, payment in Odoo → invoice paid, account renewed; wrong API key → clear error in the console. API crawl of 600 endpoints with no server errors (shared and own database).

sections.section: ZEO Books – update package, version 1.79.5 (20 November 2026) › 43. Workflow automation – one engine for every app (1.29.0)
sections.text:
An administrator writes business rules without code and they run by themselves in HR, Payroll, Projects, CRM,
Property, Maintenance and HSE. Settings → **Automation** (the "bolt" app). Phases 1 and 2 of the workflow
specification are delivered: core automation (rules, triggers, condition builder, e-mail, notifications, tasks, field
updates) and business processes (approval engine, scheduled actions, conditional branches, record creation,
escalation). Phase 3 items that came naturally with the engine are in as well: execution logs with retries, versions
with rollback, and the configuration audit.

sections.section: ZEO Books – update package, version 1.79.5 (20 November 2026) › 43. Workflow automation – one engine for every app (1.29.0) › 43.1 A rule
sections.text:
**WHEN** (trigger) → **IF** (conditions) → **THEN** (actions, in order). The editor is a five-step wizard:

1. **Basics** – name, module, record type (every record type of every installed app is offered; nothing to
   register), owner, description.
2. **Trigger** – *When a record is created* · *When a record is updated* · *When a selected field changes* (optionally
   only from / to a value) · *On, before or after a date field* ("30 days before Visa expiry") · *At a scheduled time*
   (hourly, daily, weekly, monthly, company time) · *By hand* (Run button / API). Timing and limits: delayed start
   (minutes), at most once per record, runs per day.
3. **Conditions** – AND / OR groups, nested up to three levels. Operators: equals, not equals, contains, does not
   contain, starts / ends with, greater / less (or equal), between, in list, is empty / not empty, is true / false,
   changed, changed from, changed to, date before / after, date is today, date is overdue, related record exists.
   Fields of the record and one level of linked records (Employee › Department, Branch › Code …) with the right input
   per type (choices, dates with `today`, `today+30`, users).
4. **Actions** – *Send an e-mail* (template or text, variables), *Send an in-app notification* (bell), *Create a
   task / call / meeting* (an activity on the record with a due date), *Update fields*, *Create a related record*
   (field mapping, linked back to the source), *Assign an owner* (user, role, round robin in a role, the employee's
   manager, the record owner, the user who made the change), *Submit for approval* (with actions on approval and on
   rejection), *Wait* (days / hours / minutes or until a date field ± days), *Conditional branch* (if … then … else …,
   nested), *Stop*. Each action can be disa

   record owner / employee, the employee's manager, the employee (e-mail), the user who made the change, a user, a
   role, a user field of the record, an address.
5. **Review & test** – a readable summary, the problems that block activation, and **Test on a record**: a dry run

change), `{{ user.name }}`, `{{ user.email }}`, `{{ company.name }}`, `{{ today }}`, `{{ now }}`, `{{ link }}` (the
record's page). Linked values print as their name, dates as dd/mm/yyyy.

**Load sample rules** (Rules page) creates five working examples as drafts: welcome a new employee, probation review
30 days before confirmation, designation change → HR, visa expires in 60 days, leave request → manager with a
2-day reminder (wait + branch).

sections.section: ZEO Books – update package, version 1.79.5 (20 November 2026) › 43. Workflow automation – one engine for every app (1.29.0) › 43.2 Lifecycle, versions, limits
sections.text:
Draft → **Activate** (publishes version 1) → Deactivate / Archive; a later activation of a changed rule publishes
the next version and the previous versions are kept (rollback to any published version from the API; the editor
shows the version). Duplicate makes a draft copy. Loop protection: a rule's action that saves a record may start
other rules at most three levels deep and never the same rule on the same record inside one chain. Per-record
"once" and per-day limits are enforced per rule. Rules are cached a minute per company.

sections.section: ZEO Books – update package, version 1.79.5 (20 November 2026) › 43. Workflow automation – one engine for every app (1.29.0) › 43.3 The engine (how it runs)
sections.text:
- Create / update / field-change triggers run inside the save (signals), after the change history is written, with
  the old values of the record for *changed from / to* and `{{ old.x }}`.
- Date triggers, schedules, waits, delayed starts and approval reminders run from the **scheduler** every 15 minutes:
  Celery beat `ZeoFlow.tasks.run_due` (added to `CELERY_BEAT_SCHEDULE`), or `python manage.py run_workflows`
  from cron, or the *Run the scheduler now* button on Scheduled actions. A date trigger runs once a day per record.
- Every run is logged (**Execution log**): rule and version, record, trigger, who or what started it (user, system,
  schedule, approval, retry), start / finish / duration, every action with its result (ok, skipped, waiting, failed,
  stopped) and detail, the error, retries and a correlation id that links a run with the runs it started (approval
  callbacks). Filters by rule, status, record type, date and text. **Retry** runs the failed step and the ones after
  it again.
- **Scheduled actions**: pending, overdue, done, cancelled, failed; a pending one can be cancelled (the run stops).

sections.section: ZEO Books – update package, version 1.79.5 (20 November 2026) › 43. Workflow automation – one engine for every app (1.29.0) › 43.4 Approval engine
sections.text:
Settings → Automation → **Approval flows**: for a record type, the levels in order; in a level either the first
approver to decide wins or everyone must approve (parallel). Approvers by: the employee's reporting manager, the
submitter's manager, the department head, the record owner, a user, a role, a user field of the record. Per level:
amount-based routing (only when a numeric field is at least …), deadline in hours (then a reminder a day and
escalation to a chosen user, who may decide), name. Flow options: self-approval allowed or not (by default the
submitter is never asked to approve their own request), comment required to reject, and an optional status field of
the record set to a pending / approved / rejected value.

**Approvals** (Settings → Automation → My approvals, also Requests › Workflow approvals in HR): for me / submitted
by me / history / all (admins). Approve, reject (comment), ask for changes, delegate to another user; the submitter
can cancel a pending request and submit a rejected or returned one again. Every decision, comment, delegation and
escalation is in the trail. Approvers are notified in the bell and by e-mail; the submitter is told the outcome.
A flow is started by the *Submit for approval* action of a rule (with *when approved* / *when rejected* actions),
by the **Submit a record** button on the flow, or by `POST /flow/api/approvals/submit/ {flow, model, id, note}`.

sections.section: ZEO Books – update package, version 1.79.5 (20 November 2026) › 43. Workflow automation – one engine for every app (1.29.0) › 43.5 Notifications and templates
sections.text:
**Notification templates**: e-mail / in-app / both, subject and body with variables, record type for the preview
(*Preview with a record*). Rules may use a template or write the text inline. In-app notifications of the rules and
the approval engine appear in the bell as **Automation**; a click opens the record (or the approvals page) and marks
it read.

sections.section: ZEO Books – update package, version 1.79.5 (20 November 2026) › 43. Workflow automation – one engine for every app (1.29.0) › 43.6 Security and governance
sections.text:
- Rights (User grouping → All other modules → Automation): `view_workflow` sees the automation pages, `change_workflow`
  creates / changes / activates rules and retries runs, `view_/change_approvalflow` the approval flows, templates and
  the rest by their own rights; company administrators have everything. My approvals needs no right.
- Every company is its own tenant: rules, runs, approvals and templates live in the company schema.
- **Configuration changes** page: who created, changed, activated, deactivated, archived, duplicated, rolled back or
  deleted which rule, flow or template, when.
- E-mails go through the server's mail settings; nothing external is called in this phase (webhooks, custom
  functions and the visual designer are phases 3 and 4).

sections.section: ZEO Books – update package, version 1.79.5 (20 November 2026) › 44. Location level – switcher, access, numbering and tagging per location (1.30.0)
sections.text:
A **location** (site, shop, project office, camp, warehouse) is a place inside a branch. Until now it was a master of the
employee form only. With **HR → Organisation → Location level** switched on it becomes a working level under the branch,
the way the branch already is:

- every active location belongs to **one branch** (Locations page: *Branch*, *Location manager*, *Default location of the branch*);
- the **header switcher** (company ▸ branches) gets a *Locations* block with the locations of the selected branches:
  ticked locations filter every list, dashboard and report; **Work here** marks the working location that new records are
  made in. The choice is remembered per user (browser) and sent to the API as `X-Zeo-Locations` / `X-Zeo-Location`;
- **every transaction is tagged with its location** when it is created – body `zeo_location`, else the working location,
  else the employee's location. The tag is a side table (`OrgStructure.RecordLocation`), so no transaction table is changed
  and no migration of the core apps is needed. The record panel of every form shows *Location: …* with **Change** for users
  who may change the record;
- **Location access** (HR → Organisation): the locations a user may work in; empty = every location of the user's branches;
  a user with none there but with a location on the employee record is limited to that one. With *Restrict users by
  location* on, such a user sees and changes only the records tagged with those locations (plus untagged records of
  employees of those locations or of employees without a location), only the employees of those locations, and is refused

sections.text:
While location-level control is on, the location is a dimension of every report and dashboard the way the branch is:

  locations (header `X-Zeo-Locations`, sent by the app on every call) – or of `?location=1,2` picked on the report page

  switcher's / the user's locations the same way.

sections.section: ZEO Books – update package, version 1.79.5 (20 November 2026) › 47. The same interface in every browser (1.32.1)
sections.text:
ZEO's screens were rendered in Chromium (Chrome / Edge) and in WebKit 2.52 (the Safari engine) at desktop (1366 px) and phone
(390 px) width – employees, leave policies, requests, report centre, automation, login: the layout, fonts, tables, cards, buttons
and the phone card view are the same in both; only native widgets differ slightly (date-input placeholder, select arrows, focus ring).
When one browser shows a different interface from another, the cause is not the rendering but **which build the browser has**:

1. **A cached `index.html`.** The nginx site had no cache rule, so a browser could keep the previous `index.html` for hours or
   days. That page names the previous hashed bundles: the browser then shows the old version – or a blank / half-working screen
   once the old bundles were replaced – while a browser that fetched the page fresh shows the new one. `deploy/nginx-zeo.conf`
   now sends `Cache-Control: no-cache, no-store` for `index.html` and `assets/env.js` (always re-read), caches the hashed bundles
   for a year (their names change with every build) and keeps `/static/` and `/media/` with `^~`.
2. **A missing API path in nginx.** The site file listed the API prefixes up to 1.21.0; the apps added since (`flow/` –
   Automation, `cloud/`, `group/`, `licence/`, `mobile/`, `mobile-co/`, `blog/`) fell through to the Angular page, so on a
   server with that file those screens stayed empty while they worked on another server (or on localhost with `ng serve`).
   The prefixes are added. If your site file is your own, add them to the `location ~ ^/(…)/` list.
3. **Self-healing in the app.** `shared-ui/z-stale-build.handler.ts` (registered as Angular's ErrorHandler): when a lazy
   bundle cannot be loaded after a deploy (ChunkLoadError / "Failed to fetch dynamic

sections.text:
1. Opportunity → **New quotation** (or Quotations → New) – customer, contact, price book and payment term come from the account.
2. **Lines**: product (or free text), description, qty, unit, unit price, discount %, tax – net per line while typing; totals on save.
3. Save: *Draft*, or *Needs approval* when a discount is above the limit or a line is below the minimum price (the reason is shown;
   managers get a to-do). Approve / Refuse.
4. **Mark sent / e-mail** – e-mails the quotation summary to the contact (company e-mail settings) and moves the opportunity to its
   proposal stage. **PDF** – A4 with the company's legal name, TRN, logo, letterhead header / footer, signatory and stamp
   (Organisation → Company profile, 1.31.0), lines, totals, notes, terms and an acceptance box.
5. **Accepted** – creates the **sales order** (unless unticked), sets the opportunity value, optionally marks the opportunity won,
   turns a prospect account / contact into a customer, rejects the other open quotations of the opportunity, and calls the
   `quote_accepted` hook of linked apps. **Rejected** with a lost reason. **Make a revision** – a copy with revision + 1.
6. Sales order: In progress → Delivered (delivery note / project ref.) → Invoiced (invoice ref., managers) → Close. The
   `order_status` hook tells linked apps; `order_update` lets them write the delivery / invoice reference back.

sections.text:
> Asset Management was built on 1.32.1 as its own line (its README called it 1.33.0 / 1.34.0); in this package it is merged with
> the CRM sales management of 1.33.0 / 1.33.1. Everything below applies to 1.34.0. Its own numbering of the earlier sections has
> been renumbered to 49 and 50 here.

Asset Management is a new app in **Settings → Apps** (next to CRM, Property, Maintenance and HSE), built on the same app kit:
its own menu, roles, home page, industry packs and Setup. **HR → Assets stays as it is.** Once Asset Management is activated
it is connected by itself:

| Connected with | How |
|---|---|
| **HR → Assets** (always) | **One shared register.** Every asset card is an HR asset (`OrganisationManager.Asset` + the AssetPlus profile). On activation every existing HR asset gets its card; an asset added in HR appears in Asset Management at once, and an asset added in Asset Management appears in HR. Check-out / check-in, transfers, disposal and physical checks run through the HR asset services, so **employee custody, asset requests, damage / loss recovery through payroll, exit clearance and HSE** keep working on the same assets. HR asset page → "Open in Asset Management ›". |
| **Maintenance** (when active) | Critical and high assets (or all – setting) are sent to Maintenance as its assets; **Report a fault** on an asset opens a Maintenance work order on it; the asset shows its work orders. |
| **Property** (when active) | Assets and locations can be placed in Property buildings and units. |

sections.text:
1. **Register** – categories with depreciation rule and GL accounts (each category is an HR asset type; codes from the
   category prefix, e.g. `IT-0001`), a location tree (site › building › floor › room / store / vehicle / external site, with
   GPS and a person in charge), parent / child assets (parts and components), criticality, ownership (owned / leased with
   lessor and lease end / third party), supplier, invoice, purchase order, warranty, RFID tag, GPS tracker id.
2. **QR / barcode labels** – Register › Print labels: chosen assets, a whole location or a category; A4 PDF sheets in three
   sizes (50 × 25, 70 × 35, 100 × 50 mm) with QR code, Code 128 barcode, code and name. The QR content is the same as HR's
   label (`ASSET:<code>|SN:<serial>|ID:<id>`), so both scanners read both labels.
3. **Scan** – Asset home › Scan an asset: phone / laptop camera (QR and barcodes), USB or Bluetooth scanner, or a typed code,
   serial number or RFID tag; the asset opens with its actions (check in, move, physical check …). Each scan is logged.
4. **Check-out / check-in, moves, transfers** – to an employee, a department or a location, with a due-back date (overdue
   returns on the home page and a daily to-do); check-in with condition and missing accessories (damage goes to HR's damage
   process); moves between locations; transfers wait for the asset manager's approval (same AssetTransfer as HR).
   Every movement is listed (Register › Movements).
5. **Reservations** – book an asset for a period (pool cars, projectors, tools); bookings cannot overlap; employees request,
   the coordinator confirms and checks out; not-collected bookings are cancelled the day after.
6. **Asset counts (physical verification)** – choose a location (with every place inside) and categories, auditors,

- **Note on migrations:** `ZeoCloud/migrations/0001…0004` depend on `UserManagement 0002_alter_company_industry_type`,
  which is not in the package (it is made on each server by `makemigrations`). On a brand-new server run

sections.section: ZEO Books – update package, version 1.79.5 (20 November 2026) › 49. Asset Management – a separate app connected to HR → Assets (1.34.0) › 49.6 Deploy (see deploy step 47)
sections.text:
Backend
1. Copy `backend/` over the project (or apply `zeo-1.32.1-to-1.34.0-backend.patch` on 1.32.1). New app `ZeoAssets`;
   changed: `zeo/settings.py` (TENANT_APPS + `'ZeoAssets'`), `zeo/urls.py` (`zeo-assets/`), `ZeoApps`, `ZeoCloud`,
   `ZeoLicence`, `ZeoFlow/registry.py`, `ZeoMaintenance/app.py`, `OrgStructure/location.py`.
2. `python manage.py migrate_schemas` – adds the `ZeoAssets` tables to every company (nothing else changes).
3. `python manage.py zeoapps_setup --roles` – makes the "Asset Management – …" permission groups in every company.
4. nginx: add `zeo-assets` to the API path list (`deploy/nginx-zeo.conf` has it), then `nginx -t && systemctl reload nginx`.
5. Restart gunicorn and Celery (the daily job of the kit apps now also runs Asset Management: HR sync, overdue to-dos).
6. ZEO Cloud / Enterprise: `assets` is a new app key – add it to the plans or licences that should include it.

Frontend
1. Copy `frontend/hrms-project/` over the project (or apply `zeo-1.32.1-to-1.34.0-frontend.patch`).
2. `npm install` (nothing new – the camera scanner uses `html5-qrcode`, already in package.json) and `ng build`.

Activate
- Settings → Apps → **Asset Management** → Activate (industry from the company master, or choose). Your HR assets appear in
  Asset Management › Register › Assets. Give the permission groups to the users.
- Setup › Categories: check useful lives and fill the GL accounts. Setup › Locations: add your sites and rooms.
- For assets bought before go-live, enter the opening accumulated depreciation and "depreciated up to" date (or let the
  first run catch up).
