sections.section: ZEO Books – update package, version 1.79.5 (20 November 2026) › 50. Asset Management release 2 – maintenance, helpdesk, spare parts, field screen (1.34.0) › 50.1 Maintenance and work orders
sections.text:
- **Activity types** (service, IT PM, vehicle service, AC PM, generator service, safety inspection, calibration, repair,
  breakdown) with their checklist, usual hours and "asset out of service during the work". Come with every industry pack.
- **Maintenance plans** – every N days / weeks / months, or every N km / hours of the meter reading; for one asset or for
  every asset of a category; team, technician, vendor, estimate, lead days. The daily job makes the work orders before each
  due date (meter plans when the reading is reached); "Create due work orders now" on a plan does it at once. No duplicates.
- **Maintenance calendar** – work orders by planned date and the coming plan dates, month by month, late ones in red.
- **Work orders** – preventive, corrective, breakdown, inspection, calibration; priority; team and technician; planned
  date and finish-by date; checklist from the activity; **approval** when the estimate is above the limit in Settings;
  Start (meter reading) → Checklist → Use parts (issued from a store) → Work done (what was done, labour hours × rate,
  vendor cost, downtime) → Close. **Out of service**: starting writes HR's maintenance record (asset "Under maintenance" in
  HR and here); Work done closes it with the cost and downtime – the maintenance history is the same in HR → Assets.
- **Hand-over to the Maintenance app**: Settings › "hand work orders over to the Maintenance app" – when the Maintenance
  app is active and linked, new work orders are created there on the Maintenance asset; their status and cost come back
  every 15 minutes and close the work order here.
- Asset record: **New work order**, **Raise a ticket**, and the asset's work orders, tickets and plans.

sections.text:
- Tickets about an asset: breakdown, complaint, incident (damage, loss, safety) or service request; raised by any employee
  (they see their own), by the helpdesk, from a scan, from a phone (photo / video, GPS) or **by e-mail**.
- **SLA rules** by priority (respond / fix / escalate hours; urgent 1 / 4 h, high 2 / 8 h, normal 4 / 24 h, low 8 / 72 h).
- **Escalation** every 15 minutes: past the first-response or fix time → level 1 (team leader), then level 2 (asset
  managers), each with an e-mail and a to-do.
- Assign to a team and a person, ask the user, create a work order (which resolves the ticket when done), resolve with
  the repair cost; the user **confirms** with a rating (1–5) and feedback, or **reopens** it.
- **E-mail to ticket**: Setup › Settings (IMAP server, user, "create tickets from e-mail") and Setup › Import and mailbox
  (password – stored on the server, never shown). A mail opens a ticket; an asset code in the subject or text (IT-0003)
  links the asset; a reply with [AHD-00012] in the subject goes to that ticket; automatic replies are skipped. Standard
  library only, no paid service.

sections.section: ZEO Books – update package, version 1.79.5 (20 November 2026) › 51. Accounting integration – Odoo, Zoho Books, Excel / CSV and the ZEO API (1.35.0)
sections.text:
> Accounting integration was built on 1.34.0 as its own line; in this package it is merged with everything else of 1.35.0.
> Its own section number (50) is 51 here.

Payroll → **Accounting journals** (new menu group "Accounting" in Payroll). ZEO turns HR and payroll events into balanced
journal entries and sends them to the company's accounting application – **API first**: nothing is typed twice.

| Source | Journal |
|---|---|
| **Payroll run** (approved / paid) | Dr expense per addition · Cr liability per deduction · employer contributions ("others" components, e.g. GPSSA employer) Dr expense / Cr liability · Cr salaries payable for the net · rounding line |
| **Month-end provisions** | gratuity and leave salary (the same figures as the Gratuity and Leave liability reports): only the **change** since the last posted provision, per employee (Dr expense / Cr provision; a fall is the other way round) |
| **Final settlement** (approved / paid) | gratuity and leave pay are taken from the employee's provision first, the rest is expense; other lines by their account; Cr final settlement payable |
| **Expense claims** | approved reports of a period: Dr category account · Cr advances used · Cr reimbursements due (a report is never taken twice) |

sections.text:
Posting rules and connection, per company:

| | Not posted | Analytic account / reporting tag | Separate GL code | GL code and analytic | Partner |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Department** | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | |
| **Employee** | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ (partner / contact on the line) |
| **Branch** | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | |

- **Lines that carry them**: cost (expense) lines only – one salaries-payable line for everyone – or **every line**
  (payable and deductions split per department / employee too).
- **GL code**: an account set for one department or employee in the Accounts tab ("+ for a department") is used as it is;
  otherwise the pattern – `{account}-{dept}`, `{account}-{emp}`, `{account}-{branch}` (changeable, e.g. `{account}{dept}`) –
  with the GL code of the Departments / Employees tab, or the ZEO department / employee code. Example: Basic of Sara (IT) on
  6100 → `6100-IT`; with employee GL as well → `6100-IT-E001`.
- **Analytic**: Odoo analytic accounts in the plans *Department*, *Employee*, *Branch* (one line carries all of them);
  Zoho Books reporting tags *Department*, *Employee*, *Branch*. "Match with the accounting app" links them by code / name;
  "Match and create the missing" makes them there.
- The department / employee / branch are **frozen on each journal line** when it is built: a transfer later never moves a
  cost already posted.
- A journal with something missing (no account, department without analytic account, employee without GL code …) stays
  **Draft – check it** with the reason; "Check again" after the mapping is filled.

sections.text:
| Application | How |
|---|---|
| **Odoo 19 and later** | JSON-2 API (`/json/2/<model>/<method>`, API key as bearer, `X-Odoo-Database`). Posts an `account.move` (journal entry) in the journal with the code of the settings, draft or posted. |
| **Odoo 14 – 18** | XML-RPC with the user's login and API key (Odoo removes XML-RPC in Odoo 22 / Online 21.1 – move to JSON-2 when you upgrade Odoo). |
| **Zoho Books** | REST API v3, OAuth 2 refresh token (self client, scope `ZohoBooks.fullaccess.all`), organisation id, data-centre domains (.com, .eu, .in, .com.au, .sa, .ae …). Posts a journal, draft or published. |
| **Tally, Sage, QuickBooks, Xero, any other** | Excel / CSV download with account, base account, department, employee, branch and analytic columns; "Mark as entered / exported". |
| **Pulled by another application** | ZEO API v1 (below) – the application reads ready journals and confirms each one it posted. |

- Never a second entry for the same journal: Odoo is searched by the move reference (`ZEO <journal number> …`), Zoho by the
  reference number, before anything is created – a retry after a lost answer finds the first one.
- A failed posting keeps the error on the journal and is **retried every hour** (5 tries); "Find missing accounts" lists the
  GL codes the accounting app does not have, and "Create them there" makes them with the type of the base account.
- **Reverse** instead of edit: a posted / exported journal gets a reversing journal (debits and credits swapped) that is
  posted to the same application; the source can then be built again. Provisions go back to the earlier balance.
- Secrets (Odoo API key, Zoho client secret and refresh token) are stored **encrypted** (Fernet, key from the server's
  SECRET_KEY) and never sent back to the browser. If SECRET

sections.text:
Posting rules and connection → **API and webhooks** → "+ Application" gives a client id and a secret (shown once, ZEO keeps
only a hash).

```
POST /accounting/v1/token/?schema=<company>        {"client_id": "...", "client_secret": "..."}   → access_token (1 hour)
GET  /accounting/v1/journals/?schema=<company>&status=ready&lines=1&since=<last id>   Authorization: Bearer <token>
GET  /accounting/v1/journals/<id>/?schema=<company>
POST /accounting/v1/journals/<id>/ack/?schema=<company>  {"external_id": "...", "external_ref": "..."}   → posted
```

1. Copy `backend/` and `frontend/hrms-project/` (or apply `zeo-1.32.1-to-1.35.0-backend.patch` / `-frontend.patch` on

reports "nothing to report". Attendance: 5 lates in 30 days, 3 missed punches, 4 Monday absences flagged with the text; coverage
for 14 days; replacements for an absent employee scored (same designation and department first); roster recommended for two
weeks. Recruitment: HSE Officer opening, 3 candidates with PDF CVs read (years, NEBOSH / IOSH / OSHA / ISO 45001, languages,
nationality, visa, notice period, driving licence, employer), scores 89 / 76 / 31 with the missing skills, JD, 14 questions,
slots, invitation draft with the booked interview's time and venue, pipeline 0 / 2 / 1 / 0 / 0, 40 days open. Performance: Bilal –
two cycles summarised (3.55 → 3.25, weakest goals, themes "team, delegation, leadership"), 3 skill gaps (readiness 65 %), NEBOSH IGC
and Leading Teams recommended, 9 objectives, certificate expiring in 25 days and one expired, plan draft with 5 steps saved to
People. Workforce: headcount 20 with forecast, budget with 5 % growth and 5 % increment from January, Finance flagged for absence
5.3 %, 1 hire needed at 10 % growth, cost by department and by company (Q7 group, 3 companies); the same questions answered in Ask
ZEO.

sections.section: ZEO Books – update package, version 1.79.5 (20 November 2026) › 57. Form layout designer – "Arrange fields" on every screen (1.39.0)
sections.text:
Every form in ZEO – the HRMS screens (leave request, employee, payroll, recruitment…), the kit apps (Asset Management, CRM, Property, Maintenance, People, Projects), the HSE / Expense / Projects modals and the employee page – now has a button **Arrange fields** next to the record notes. It opens the form in design mode, the way Odoo Studio does:

| Action | How |
|---|---|
| Move a field | Drag it by its handle (⋮⋮) and drop it on the field it should go before. The standard fields **and** the extra fields made in Settings → Form designer are all draggable – an extra field can sit between two standard ones instead of at the bottom. |
| Width | The select on each handle: Auto (as built), ¼, ⅓, ½, Full. On bootstrap forms it replaces the column classes; on the kit grids it spans the grid; on the HSE / Expense forms it uses the two-column grid. |
| Hide a field | The eye on the handle. A required field (marked *) has no eye – it can only be moved. A hidden field is still sent to the server with its default, so validation is unchanged. |
| Section title | The ¶ button on a handle asks for a title and shows it above that field (e.g. "Dates" above Start date). |
| Save layout | Saves for the **company** (per screen): every user who opens that form sees the arranged layout; the people who can design it see the button. |
| Reset to default | Deletes the saved layout and puts the form back exactly as built, there and then. |
| Cancel | Leaves design mode; the saved layout (if any) is applied again. |

What is stored: `Chatter.FormLayout` – one row per screen (`screen` = the API endpoint of the form, the same key the form designer uses), `data` = `{blocks: [{key, width, hidden}], sections: [{before, title}]}`. Keys are stable names (`name:<control name>`, `extra:<designer field>`

sections.section: ZEO Books – update package, version 1.79.5 (20 November 2026) › 60. Business partners – one master for people and companies (1.41.0, shared masters phase 1)
sections.text: The *ZEO Shared Masters* proposal (scope document and deck of 22 October), phase 1. A tenant is a customer, a CRM contact is a customer, a vendor is a supplier – the same person or company is now **one business partner** that every app uses, the way Odoo (`res.partner`), SAP S/4HANA (Business Partner) and Dynamics 365 (Global Address Book) work. The master keeps what every app and Accounting need to recognise, contact, invoice and pay the party; each app keeps its own details in its own record.

sections.section: ZEO Books – update package, version 1.79.5 (20 November 2026) › 60. Business partners – one master for people and companies (1.41.0, shared masters phase 1) › 60.1 What a business partner is
sections.text:
| | |
|---|---|
| Individual or company | One table with a kind (Odoo: *Is a company*). Individuals: first / middle / last name, Arabic name, gender, date of birth, nationality, ID type / number / expiry (country pack: Emirates ID, Civil ID, QID, Iqama, Aadhaar…). Companies: legal name, tax registration (TRN / VAT / GSTIN), trade licence + expiry, authority |
| People of a company | A person (or an invoice / delivery address) can belong to a company partner – Odoo's child contacts. A CRM contact in an account is a person of the account's company. Balances and credit limit roll up to the company (Odoo *commercial partner*) |
| Contact | Mobile, phone, other phones (table), e-mail, website, main address, other addresses (table), preferred language and channel |
| Roles | Customer, prospect, supplier, tenant, buyer, owner, broker, contractor, student, guardian, patient, insurer, employee, other – added by the apps when they use the partner (a role is given on first use, not to everyone) |
| Commercial | Payment term, price book, currency, credit limit |
| Status | Active · **Blocked** (with the reason – no new business in any app) · Archived (hidden from pickers; records stay) |
| Links | Portal login, employee, accounting partner id, consent and retention dates, **Used in apps** (the app records of the partner, clickable) |
| Bank accounts | Child list (bank, holder, account no., IBAN with the check-digit test, SWIFT, currency, default) – managers only |

Numbering: one series **BP-00001**; the app records keep their own numbers (TB-, CON-, ACC-, VND-…), and the partner can be found by them.

sections.text:
- **Same ID number or tax number** = same legal person / company: the new app record is linked to the existing partner automatically (history note on the partner).
- **Same phone or e-mail**: saving warns – *"X (BP-00012) is already a business partner with this phone. Use it, or save again to make a new partner."* The form offers **Use BP-00012** and **Save as a new partner**. A new partner made this way is listed under **Possible duplicates**.
- **Possible duplicates** (CRM → Customers, Property → Leasing & sales): each pair side by side (matching values highlighted), with **Merge – keep the first / the second** and **Not a duplicate**. A company and its own contact person sharing the office phone are not flagged.
- **Merge** moves every record of the other partner (contacts, accounts, tenants, owners, brokers, vendors, people of the company, bank accounts) to the kept partner, fills its empty fields, keeps the other phones and archives the other partner pointing to the kept one. It **cannot be undone automatically** – Masters managers and administrators only; logged on both partners.
- **Who changes what** (Masters settings *lock_shared*, on): names, phones, e-mail, IDs and tax numbers of a partner **used by more than one app** are changed by a Masters manager, the manager of an app (CRM manager, Property manager…) or an administrator; others get *"… is used in CRM, Property: its phone is changed in Business partners by a manager."* A partner used by one app only is edited there as before. App-only fields are never locked.
- **Seeing partners**: everyone with a role in a business app (they pick partners on their forms); ID number and date of birth are restricted to managers; bank accounts to managers.

sections.text:
- New setting (Accounting → Settings) **Business partner on receivable / payable lines** (on): Property receivable, deposit, owner, vendor and broker lines carry the partner – the Odoo partner / Zoho contact id (`accounting_ref`), or the BP number in Excel / CSV / API exports. A partner not yet in the accounting app is listed as a warning on the journal (it does not stop posting).
- Accounting → Departments / employees / branches → **Match / create business partners** (`POST /accounting/api/partners/auto/` with `{"business": true, "create": true}`) matches the business partners in Odoo (by reference = BP number, then by VAT) or Zoho (by contact number) and creates the missing ones (company flag, VAT, e-mail).
- **ZEO API v1** for another accounting application: `GET /accounting/v1/partners/?updated_since=…&page=…` (names, company, roles, tax no., structured address, e-invoice ids, payment term, credit limit and hold, balances, bank accounts), `POST /accounting/v1/partners/<id>/ref/` (its own id of the partner), `GET /accounting/v1/items/` (kind, unit and its e-invoice code, tax and tax category, valuation, stock value, accounts).

sections.section: ZEO Books – update package, version 1.79.5 (20 November 2026) › 64. Collaboration on every record – followers, messages, inbox, stars, tags, mass actions, org chart moves, employee timeline (1.45.0)
sections.text: The roadmap items planned as "1.39" (1 Followers / Send message / @mentions, 2 Inbox, 3 Starred and recent, 5 Duplicate / merge, 6 Mass actions, 7 Tags, 10 Org chart, 11 Employee timeline), built into the shared record footer and list bar so every screen of every app gets them. No new app.

sections.section: ZEO Books – update package, version 1.79.5 (20 November 2026) › 64. Collaboration on every record – followers, messages, inbox, stars, tags, mass actions, org chart moves, employee timeline (1.45.0) › 64.1 Followers, Send message, @mentions, e-mail replies (Odoo chatter)
sections.text:
- **Followers** of a record are added automatically: the person who created it, the employee of an employee record, whoever writes on it, activity assignees, approvers and @mentioned people. **Follow / Following** and the followers list (add users or outside e-mail addresses, remove) sit at the top of the record footer. Unfollowing is remembered – the person is not added back automatically.
- **Send message** (next to Log note): a To: line with the followers (plus extra e-mail addresses), optional subject, attachments. Each user follower gets an inbox line, a bell notification and an e-mail with a link to the record; outside followers get the e-mail. Shown in the history with an envelope and the recipients.
- **Log note** stays internal; only the people @mentioned in it are told.
- **@mentions**: type @ in a note or message and pick a person; the person follows the record and gets a "mentioned you" line in the inbox (and an e-mail).
- **Replies by e-mail**: messages go out with Reply-To the company reply mailbox and `[ZEO#M<id>]` in the subject. The mailbox job (every 5 minutes) puts a reply back on the record as "replied by e-mail" (the quoted earlier message is cut off), adds the sender as a follower and tells the followers. Settings → **Messages and tags** (administrators): reply address, IMAP server, user, password (kept encrypted), folder, *Check now*, last check and errors.

sections.section: ZEO Books – update package, version 1.79.5 (20 November 2026) › 64. Collaboration on every record – followers, messages, inbox, stars, tags, mass actions, org chart moves, employee timeline (1.45.0) › 64.2 Inbox (Odoo Discuss)
sections.text: The inbox icon in the top bar (with the unread count) opens **one list of everything addressed to me** across the apps: messages on records I follow, @mentions, e-mail replies, my open activities, approvals waiting for me and transfer requests (HR). Filters by kind and by app, *Unread only*, *Show done*; each line opens its record; Mark read / unread, Done, Mark all read.

sections.section: ZEO Books – update package, version 1.79.5 (20 November 2026) › 64. Collaboration on every record – followers, messages, inbox, stars, tags, mass actions, org chart moves, employee timeline (1.45.0) › 64.3 Starred and recently viewed
sections.text: A star at the top of the record footer stars any record. **Starred** and **Recently viewed** (the last 30 records opened) appear in the app launcher (grid button) and on the home page, with the app of each record.

sections.section: ZEO Books – update package, version 1.79.5 (20 November 2026) › 64. Collaboration on every record – followers, messages, inbox, stars, tags, mass actions, org chart moves, employee timeline (1.45.0) › 64.4 Duplicate and merge
sections.text:
- **Duplicate** on every app-kit record (CRM, Property, Maintenance, Asset Management, People, Masters…): a copy with a new number; unique codes get -COPY, the name "(copy)"; status, files and history start again; links to the shared masters (business partner, item) are not copied – the copy gets its own.
- **Merge**: business partners, items and CRM contacts already merge (1.41–1.43). New: **candidates** – Recruitment › Candidates › *Possible duplicates* (same e-mail or phone) and *Merge into…* on a candidate: applications, documents, notes, files, tags and followers move to the candidate kept, empty details are filled, the other is deleted. Two applications for the same job stop the merge (withdraw one first).

sections.section: ZEO Books – update package, version 1.79.5 (20 November 2026) › 64. Collaboration on every record – followers, messages, inbox, stars, tags, mass actions, org chart moves, employee timeline (1.45.0) › 64.5 Mass actions on lists
sections.text: Select rows in any list → **Action ▾** in the footer: add / remove a tag, send a message to the followers of each record, schedule an activity, follow, export the selected rows, delete. On app-kit lists also every **workflow action** of the register (e.g. Archive, Block, Approve – the action's own fields are asked once) and **change a choice field** (status, channel…). Every row goes through the same rights and state checks as one by one; the rows that could not be done are listed with the reason.

sections.section: ZEO Books – update package, version 1.79.5 (20 November 2026) › 64. Collaboration on every record – followers, messages, inbox, stars, tags, mass actions, org chart moves, employee timeline (1.45.0) › 64.6 Colour tags on every record
sections.text: Tags (name and one of 9 colours) are added in the record footer or with the mass action; they show as a **Tags column** in the lists of every screen, so the list bar's filters, search and **Group by** work on them. Settings → Messages and tags: rename, change colour, delete (administrators delete).

sections.section: ZEO Books – update package, version 1.79.5 (20 November 2026) › 64. Collaboration on every record – followers, messages, inbox, stars, tags, mass actions, org chart moves, employee timeline (1.45.0) › 64.7 Org chart: drag to move
sections.text: On Organisation chart, drag an employee's card onto another person: a dialog asks the effective date and the reason and sends a **transfer request** (to report to that person) to HR – the inbox and the bell of every user who may transfer employees. The managers concerned or HR may ask. Employee transfer page: requests show *Requested – waiting for HR* with **Approve** (carried out now, or scheduled for its date) and **Reject**. Moves that would make a loop are not offered.

sections.section: ZEO Books – update package, version 1.79.5 (20 November 2026) › 64. Collaboration on every record – followers, messages, inbox, stars, tags, mass actions, org chart moves, employee timeline (1.45.0) › 64.8 Employee timeline (journey)
sections.text: Employee page › **Timeline**: one vertical timeline, newest first, grouped by year, with kind filters: joined, probation and confirmation, transfers and promotions, salary revisions, **leaves** (approved leave requests, back from leave), **awards** (People recognitions), **warnings** (new – verbal, written, final; *+ Warning* for HR; withdraw), **documents and letters** (employee documents added, HR letters issued), organisation and field changes, resignation, end of service and **final settlement**. API `employee-profile/api/history/<id>/?types=`; warnings `hr-actions/api/warnings/`.

sections.section: ZEO Books – update package, version 1.79.5 (20 November 2026) › 67. HR operations – disciplinary and grievance cases, exit interviews, document expiry hub and renewals, PRO services, asset handover with e-signature (1.48.0)
sections.text: Roadmap items 48, 51, 36, 37 and 47, in a new app **HR operations** (`ZeoHR`, menu HRMS → HR operations) built on the app kit (lists, saved views, record footer, files, history, reports, Excel export, global search). It is always on. The HR team works there with its existing employee rights (*change employee* = HR officer and PRO, *view employee* = viewer, *handle complaints* = cases). Four roles give finer rights: HR operations manager, HR officer, PRO, viewer.

sections.section: ZEO Books – update package, version 1.79.5 (20 November 2026) › 67. HR operations – disciplinary and grievance cases, exit interviews, document expiry hub and renewals, PRO services, asset handover with e-signature (1.48.0) › 67.1 Disciplinary and grievance cases (48)
sections.text:
A case is opened on an employee (category: misconduct, attendance, performance, policy, harassment, safety, fraud, grievance), or from an employee complaint (*From complaint* copies the complaint). It then moves through these steps:

1. **Start investigation**: names an investigator, who gets a to-do and sees the case.
2. **Send show-cause notice**: a standard text or your own. The reply date comes from Settings (3 days by default). The employee sees the notice in Self service → **Notices and decisions** and replies in writing there; HR can also record a reply given on paper.
3. **Plan the hearing**: date, place and panel. The employee is invited.
4. **Decide**: one of no action, counselling, verbal / written / final warning, fine, suspension without pay, increment held, demotion or termination.
   - A warning is added to the employee timeline (HRActions warnings).
   - A fine is limited to the Settings maximum (5 days' wage a month, UAE Decree-Law 33/2021 / KSA). A suspension is limited to 14 days by default.
   - Fines and suspensions create a to-do for payroll.
5. **Appeal**: the employee or HR records it, and the manager decides it as upheld, reduced or overturned. An overturned decision withdraws the warning.
6. **Close**: also resolves the linked complaint.

Witnesses, findings and hearing notes are restricted to HR. The **Case letter PDF** prints the show-cause notice or the decision with signature lines. The overdue show-cause replies are flagged daily.

sections.section: ZEO Books – update package, version 1.79.5 (20 November 2026) › 67. HR operations – disciplinary and grievance cases, exit interviews, document expiry hub and renewals, PRO services, asset handover with e-signature (1.48.0) › 67.2 Exit interviews (51)
sections.text:
One exit interview per leaver. The questions are the company's exit survey (People → Surveys, kind *Exit*) or nine standard questions: reason, satisfaction with the job, the manager, training and pay, would work here again, recommend 0–10, what could have kept you, anything else.
- **Send to the employee**: the employee answers in ZEO (a link in My To-do). The answers fill the main reason, *would rehire* and *recommend*.
- **Interview held**: HR adds notes (restricted), the reason and rehire.
- **Summary PDF** of the answers.
- Sent automatically when an approved resignation's last working day is within the Settings days (7). The home shows the reasons for leaving.

sections.section: ZEO Books – update package, version 1.79.5 (20 November 2026) › 67. HR operations – disciplinary and grievance cases, exit interviews, document expiry hub and renewals, PRO services, asset handover with e-signature (1.48.0) › 67.3 Document expiry hub and renewals (36)
sections.text:
HR operations → **Document expiry hub**: every current document of the employees the user may see – employee documents and identity (passport, visa, Emirates ID / iqama, labour card, work permit, driving licence, medical insurance, labour contract). Rows are grouped as expired, within 30, 60 and 90 days (look ahead up to 180), in renewal, and no renewal yet. You can search and filter by document.
- **Renew** (one row) or *Start renewal* (the ticked rows): opens a **Document renewal** assigned to the PRO from Settings (or a PRO-role user), with a to-do. The employee is told.
- On the renewal, *Open a PRO service* makes the government service that renews this document type, with its steps.
- *Renewed* (or completing the PRO service with *Valid until*) writes the new expiry back to the employee. A new number makes a new employee document and keeps the old one as history; an identity field is updated.
- Renewals start automatically every day for documents expiring within the Settings days (60).

sections.section: ZEO Books – update package, version 1.79.5 (20 November 2026) › 67. HR operations – disciplinary and grievance cases, exit interviews, document expiry hub and renewals, PRO services, asset handover with e-signature (1.48.0) › 67.4 PRO services (37)
sections.text:
Government services with the usual steps of the company's country:
- **AE**: work permit quota, entry permit, change of status, medical, Emirates ID, residence visa, labour card, MOHRE contract, cancellation, dependant visa, trade licence, establishment card, MOHRE file.
- **SA**: work visa, iqama, Qiwa work permit, exit / re-entry, final exit, transfer, GOSI, CR.
- **OM, QA, KW, IN**: their own services.
- **Common**: passport renewal, medical insurance card, driving licence, attestation, other.

Each service has the employee, a dependant, or *for the company*. It also records the government body, priority, application number, dates, fees (government, typing / service, other – total; restricted) and who pays, plus a steps checklist. The service moves through:

1. Requested
2. Collecting documents
3. Submitted
4. In process
5. Approved
6. Completed – stores the issued number and *Valid until*, and renews the linked renewal and the document. A service can also end as Rejected or Cancelled.

The HR operations home shows open and late services by type.

**Asset handover** – *Issue to the employee* or *Return by the employee*. Items are a table: asset, serial / tag, condition, accessories and note. *Add the employee's assets* fills the table from HR → Assets allocations. The terms text is editable, and there is a charge for damage / loss.
- **Send for signature**: the employee reads and signs in ZEO, drawing or typing the signature (the same signing screen as People e-signature). HR can also let the employee sign on HR's own device; this is recorded as *signed in front of*.
- The signed PDF (items, terms, signature, audit trail) is kept.
- A signed **return** closes the employee's asset allocations, with the return condition, and frees the assets.

sections.text:
Payroll → **Loans – balances and schedule**: running loans with loan amount, paid, balance, instalment, months left and the last month. A loan shows its **schedule** (paid months from the payslips, planned months after) and the list of **changes**. HR can:
- **Top-up**: adds an amount; the instalment is recalculated over the months left (or the months given).
- **New instalment**: a new monthly amount or a new number of months.
- **Early settlement**: the balance is paid now (a repayment outside payroll); the loan is closed. *At exit* marks it as settled in the final settlement.
- **Pause / resume**: no deduction between the two dates; the loan resumes by itself on the date (daily job `payrollplus-loans`).

The employee sees the same in Self service → **My loans** (read only).

sections.text:
Payroll → Accounting → **Cost allocation**.
- **Allocation rules**: per employee, *fixed percentages* over projects, cost centres (Organisation) and departments, or *timesheet hours of the month* (project timesheets; rejected entries left out), with dates from / until. What is not allocated stays on the employee's own cost centre, or the department.
- **Month**: the gross pay of the month's processed / approved / paid payslips split by the rules – where the cost goes (per project / cost centre / department) and per employee (percent, hours, amount). **CSV** for the accountant.

sections.text:
- **Employees** ask HR in Self service → **Ask HR** (also from the kiosk, see 70.4). They choose what it is about, write the question, follow HR's answers, reply, and rate the solution (1–5) or reopen it within 7 days.
- **Categories** (HR operations → Setup → Helpdesk categories): payslip or salary, leave and attendance, letter or certificate, documents / visa / ID, benefits and insurance, policy question, access to ZEO, complaint, other. Each has the time HR gives the **first answer** in and **solves** it in (hours), and who gets it.
  - A category can send the employee to the **confidential complaint** form or the **letter request** instead, so complaints keep their confidentiality.
- **HR** works in HR operations → **HR helpdesk**. A ticket has these actions: *Assign*, *Answer the employee* (optionally *wait for the employee*), *Internal note* (HR only), *Resolve*, *Reopen*, *Close*, *Cancel*.
  - The record shows the service level (respond by, fix by, on time / late) and the conversation.
  - HR can also enter a question that came by phone, e-mail or at the desk.
- **Daily**: late tickets go to the HR operations manager, and a resolved ticket closes after 7 days without a rating.
- **The HR operations home** shows open and late tickets, solved on time (30 days), the employees' rating, open tickets by category and the tickets due first.

sections.text:
On the same page: the colleague who approves for you, from and to, a note, and *also move the approvals waiting for me now*.
- Leave, late in / early out, general and document requests, assets, loans, advance salary and the other request approvals, and automation approvals, go to the colleague while you are away – those already waiting (when the period starts) and new ones as they arrive.
- The colleague is notified and sees whom they approve for.
- *I am back* ends it; a planned period can be cancelled.
- An administrator can set it for someone who is away (API `user_id`).

sections.section: ZEO Books – update package, version 1.79.5 (20 November 2026) › 71. Administration and sign-in security – authenticator app, password rules, sessions, out of office, scheduled reports, API keys and webhooks, undo an import, view as a user, system health (1.52.0) › 71.4 Scheduled reports (22)
sections.text:
Reports → **Scheduled reports**, or *Schedule* on any report:
- a report, the period (last month, this month so far, last week, yesterday, as of the day), every day / week (day) / month (day of the month) at an hour, Excel (xlsx) or CSV;
- the e-mail addresses – users schedule to their own e-mail, administrators to anyone.

The report runs with the rights and branches of the user who made the schedule. *Send now* sends it at once, and the last result is shown. The Celery beat job `zeoadmin-schedules` (every 15 minutes) sends what is due through the company's e-mail settings.

sections.section: ZEO Books – update package, version 1.79.5 (20 November 2026) › 71. Administration and sign-in security – authenticator app, password rules, sessions, out of office, scheduled reports, API keys and webhooks, undo an import, view as a user, system health (1.52.0) › 71.5 API keys and webhooks (23)
sections.text:
Settings → Administration → **API keys and webhooks** (company administrators):
- **API keys**: a name, the user the key acts as (that user's rights apply), read only (GET only – recommended), allowed IP addresses, expiry. The key is shown once and kept only as a hash. Send it as `Authorization: Api-Key zeo_…` or `X-API-Key` with `?schema=` of the company. Last use, IP and number of uses are shown; a key can be switched off or deleted.
- **Webhooks**: a URL, the record types (employees, leave, payroll, helpdesk tickets, …) and the events (created, updated, deleted).
  - ZEO POSTs JSON `{event, model, id, company, at, data}` with the header `X-ZEO-Event` and `X-ZEO-Signature: sha256=<HMAC-SHA256 of the body with the signing secret>` (the secret is shown once).
  - A failed delivery is tried again after 1, 5, 30 minutes, 2 and 6 hours (beat job `zeoadmin-webhooks`). A webhook that fails 20 times in a row is switched off.
  - *Send a test*, the deliveries with their answers, and *Try again*.
- **Automation**: the new action *Call a webhook* sends the record of the rule to one of the webhooks (event `<model>.automation`).

sections.section: ZEO Books – update package, version 1.79.5 (20 November 2026) › 71. sections.text:
Sign-in security → **View as** next to a user: ZEO opens as that user for one hour.
- **Read only** by default, so nothing can be changed. The administrator can also allow changes, which the change history shows as "by <administrator> as this user".
- A bar at the bottom shows it, and *Stop viewing as this user* returns to the administrator.
- The start and the end are written to the audit log (action *login_as*).
- Administrators cannot be viewed as, and the company can switch it off.

sections.text:
In *Import a file* of every list:
- the columns of the file can be matched to the fields by hand, and the matching is remembered for the next file with the same columns;
- after the import, *Undo this import* deletes the records it created.

Settings → Administration → **Import history** lists every import (file, rows, user) with *Undo this import*. Records already used by other records are kept, and the history says how many.

sections.text:
Reports → **Report builder** → *New report*:
- **Record type**: any record type the user may view (employees, leave requests, payslips, assets, tickets …).
- **Columns**: fields of the record and of the records it links to (for example *Department › Department name*), in the order you put them.
- **Filters**: is / is not, contains, starts with, more / less than, between, one of, empty, yes / no, before / after a date, today, this month, this year, in the last / next … days.
- **Grouping**: one row per value of a field, with the number of records and the total, average, lowest or highest of number fields.
- **Sort**, **at most … rows**, and the date field the report's period filters.
- **Who can run it**: only me, everybody who may view that record type, or chosen permission groups.

*Preview* shows the first 50 rows. *Save the report* puts it in the report centre under its heading, as the report `c-<id>`, so it works like the built-in reports:
- filters, columns, group by, export and *E-mail me*;
- *Schedule* (Scheduled reports) and *Add to a dashboard*.

The rows follow the rights of the person running it – branches and own records, as in the lists. Password, code and face-template fields are never offered.

sections.text:
Settings → Administration → **Data retention and privacy** (company administrators):
- **Retention**: anonymise employees … years after their last working day (0 = never, the default). Optionally also delete their documents and files, and the photos and files on leave, attendance, requests and payslip PDFs. Optionally do it every night (otherwise HR anonymises from the list).
- **Due for anonymising**: employees who left at least that long ago (the last working day of the resignation, else the day the record was closed). Choose them, then *Anonymise the chosen*. This cannot be undone.
  - *Removed*: the name (shown as "Former employee" and the code), date of birth, e-mails, phone numbers, addresses, parents' names, blood group, marital status, photo, face template, badge and person numbers, family members, bank accounts, qualifications, skills and extra fields. The login is switched off and its name and e-mail removed (when it is used in this company only).
  - *Kept*: the code, branch, department, designation, dates, and the payroll, leave, attendance and end-of-service records.
  - The change history is paused while it runs, so the removed values are not copied into it.
- **Export all the data about a person** (PDPL / GDPR access request): find the employee and download a zip. It holds every record linked to the employee – `all-data.json` and one CSV per record type – and their documents and photos. Secret values are never exported, and records about other people that only name the employee (for example candidates they referred) are left out.
- **Employees** download their own data in My sign-in and out of office → *Download my data*.
- Both lists (anonymised, exported) are kept.

sections.section: ZEO Books – update package, version 1.79.5 (20 November 2026) › 74. Employee documents – update the employee record from a document, upload many document files (1.53.2) › 74.1 Update the employee record from a document
sections.text:
*Fill from document* (Employee page → Document files → *Upload document* → choose the file → **Fill from document**; also on the classic employee page and its family / documents tab) still fills the document form. It now also has a second list, **Update the employee record**, for HR users who may change the employee:

| Read from the document | Saved on |
|---|---|
| Number, issue date and expiry date | the identity details of that kind: passport, residence visa, Emirates ID, labour card, driving licence or insurance card |
| An Emirates ID number on a visa, a UID number | the identity details (Emirates ID, visa UID) |
| Date of birth, nationality (from the passport code, e.g. IND → Indian), gender | the employee |
| Name (given names and surname of the MRZ) | the employee's first, middle and last name |

Each line shows the value on the record, the value on the document and **Same**, **Different** or **Not on the record**:
- New values are ticked. A different value is ticked when it can be trusted: the dates of a newer document, a date of birth or nationality checked by the machine-readable zone.
- A different name is never ticked by itself, and the dates of a document older than the one on the record are not ticked.
- *Save on the employee record* saves the ticked lines. The change history shows every changed field, and a note on the employee says, for example, "Updated from the passport (scan.pdf): Passport number, Expiry date".
- Opened from a document form, the identity details are saved without adding a document of their own – the document of the form is the one that goes into the document files.

sections.section: ZEO Books – update package, version 1.79.5 (20 November 2026) › 74. Employee documents – update the employee record from a document, upload many document files (1.53.2) › 74.2 Upload document files (zip)
sections.text:
Employees → **Upload document files** (right: add employee documents; only the employees of the user's branches). Upload one zip of up to 300 MB / 2,000 files. PDF, pictures and Word files are taken; other files are listed as not used.

**Layouts** (they can be mixed and nested):

| Layout | Example |
|---|---|
| A folder per employee | `EMP001/passport.pdf`, `EMP001/Emirates ID front.jpg` |
| A folder per document type | `Passport/EMP001.pdf`, `Visa/EMP002 Ahmed.pdf` |
| Named files in one folder | `EMP001_Passport_2032-06-14.pdf` – one date in the name is the expiry date, two dates are issue and expiry |
| A list in the zip | `index.xlsx` or `index.csv`: File, Employee Code, Document Type, Document Number, Issue Date, Expiry Date – the list wins over every guess (template on the page) |

**Matching**, in this order:
1. **Employee**: an employee code as a whole word anywhere in the folders or the file name (the longest code wins); else a passport, Emirates ID, UID, visa, labour card … number read from the document that is on an employee's identity details or documents; else the name on the document (to check); else *Employee not found*.
2. **Document type**: the words of the folders and the file name against the company's document types and their other names – PP → Passport; EID / هوية → Emirates ID; Residence / Iqama / إقامة → Visa; Work permit / LC → Labour card; DL → Driving licence; Medical → Insurance. Else the kind read from the document (MRZ). A passport, visa … with no document type of that name gets one on import.
3. **Number and dates**: the list, then the document (MRZ, labelled dates, OCR of scans), then the file name.
4. **Front and back** (or 1 and 2, page 1 and page 2) of the same document of the same employee become one PDF.
5. **Existing documents**:

sections.section: ZEO Books – update package, version 1.79.5 (20 November 2026) › 75. Single sign-on and Active Directory (1.54.0)
sections.text: Settings → **Single sign-on** (company administrators). A sign-in covers one or more e-mail domains (company.ae) and the companies whose users may use it. Public mail domains (gmail.com, outlook.com …) cannot be claimed, and a domain belongs to one sign-in only.

sections.section: ZEO Books – update package, version 1.79.5 (20 November 2026) › 75. Single sign-on and Active Directory (1.54.0) › 75.1 Kinds of sign-in
sections.text:
| Kind | What the administrator enters | What the user does |
|---|---|---|
| **Microsoft Entra ID** (Office 365, Azure AD) | directory (tenant) ID, application (client) ID, client secret | *Sign in with Microsoft* on the sign-in page |
| **Google Workspace** | client ID and secret (OAuth consent screen “Internal”) | *Sign in with Google*; only accounts of the domain (hd) |
| **Other OpenID Connect** | discovery address, client ID and secret | the company button |
| **SAML 2.0** (ADFS, Okta, OneLogin, JumpCloud …) | identity provider sign-in address, entity ID, signing certificate, optional e-mail attribute | the company button |
| **Active Directory / LDAP** (on-premises) | domain controller(s) `ldaps://dc1.company.local:636`, base DN, a read-only service account, optional StartTLS and CA certificate | types the Windows password in ZEO as before |

The page shows what to give the provider: the redirect address (OpenID Connect), the reply (ACS) address, entity ID and metadata (SAML), with copy buttons and short steps for Microsoft and Google. *Test* checks the provider (for Active Directory it also looks up a user and shows their directory and ZEO groups).

sections.section: ZEO Books – update package, version 1.79.5 (20 November 2026) › 75. Single sign-on and Active Directory (1.54.0) › 75.2 Signing in
sections.text:
- The sign-in page asks the server, after the e-mail is typed, whether its domain has a sign-in, and shows the button (or, for Active Directory, a note to use the Windows password).
- **OpenID Connect**: authorization code with PKCE; the ID token's signature (the provider's keys), issuer, audience, nonce and expiry are checked.
- **SAML**: the signed assertion is checked – signature with the stored certificate, issuer, audience, recipient, time, and that it answers ZEO's own request. A replayed or changed answer is refused.
- The provider asks for its own second step (MFA); ZEO does not ask for the e-mail code or authenticator after it. The session is listed as *sso* (or *directory*) in My sign-in.
- **Active Directory**: the password is checked by the domain controller (service account search, then a bind as the user); a disabled AD account cannot sign in. If the domain controller cannot be reached, the ZEO password works – unless *Only the domain password* is ticked.
- **Password off**: for OpenID Connect and SAML, the users of the domains can be stopped from signing in with a password.
- **Who can use it**: a login is trusted to a sign-in only when all its companies are covered by it. Server administrators (superusers) always keep their password.
- **New employees**: with *An employee … gets a self-service login*, an employee whose company or personal e-mail matches and who has no login gets a self-service login at the first sign-in, linked to the employee.
- **Phone app**: the sign-in opens in the phone's browser; the browser shows the same 4-letter code as the app and asks to confirm; the app continues by itself.

sections.section: ZEO Books – update package, version 1.79.5 (20 November 2026) › 75. Single sign-on and Active Directory (1.54.0) › 75.3 Provisioning
sections.text:
- **Directory groups → ZEO permission groups**: map a group name (Active Directory, Entra ID, Okta) to a ZEO permission group. Members get it; removed from the group, they lose it (only mapped groups are touched).
- **SCIM 2.0** (Entra ID → Enterprise application → Provisioning; Okta …): *Switch on SCIM and make a token* gives the tenant URL `https://<server>/scim/v2` and a secret token, shown once and stored hashed.
  - Users are created (in the companies of the sign-in, linked to the employee with the same e-mail), changed and switched off (signed out everywhere); *delete* switches the login off and keeps it for the history.
  - Groups send their members, which drives the group mapping.
  - Filters on userName, externalId and displayName are supported.
- **Nightly Active Directory sync** (option per sign-in, or *Synchronise now*): new directory users get logins (when logins are made), groups are updated, accounts disabled in AD are switched off. Optionally ZEO logins of the domain that are no longer in the directory are switched off. `python manage.py sync_directory [--dry] [--id N]` runs it by hand.

sections.section: ZEO Books – update package, version 1.79.5 (20 November 2026) › 75. Single sign-on and Active Directory (1.54.0) › 75.4 Security notes
sections.text:
- Client secrets and the service account password are stored encrypted; the SCIM token only as a hash.
- The browser returns only to ZEO's own address (`ZEO_APP_URL`, the allowed origins or the API host).
- Use `ldaps://` (or StartTLS). The page warns about plain `ldap://`.

sections.section: ZEO Books – update package, version 1.79.5 (20 November 2026) › 76. Pay calendars, off-cycle runs and arrears (1.55.0) › 76.1 Switching a pay frequency on
sections.text:
Every employee is paid monthly. Weekly, bi-weekly and semi-monthly pay are **off** for every company after the update, and nothing about them is shown: the menu item *Pay calendars* is hidden and no frequency can be chosen or saved.

Payroll › Setup › **Payroll controls** › *Pay frequencies* (company administrator, or a group with *Can change payroll plus settings*):

| Frequency | Periods a year | Share of the monthly salary per period |
|---|---|---|
| Weekly | 52 | 12 ÷ 52 |
| Bi-weekly | 26 | 12 ÷ 26 |
| Semi-monthly (1st – 15th, 16th – end of the month) | 24 | ½ |

- Once a frequency is ticked and saved, *Pay calendars* appears in the Payroll menu (no reload needed) and the page offers only the frequencies that are on.
- A frequency used by an active pay calendar cannot be switched off – the page names the calendar. Deactivate the calendar first (Pay calendars › delete: a calendar with runs is kept and switched off).
- A calendar of a frequency that is off is not applied by the payroll and cannot be run.
- The server checks the same rules: saving or running a calendar of a frequency that is off is refused.

sections.section: ZEO Books – update package, version 1.79.5 (20 November 2026) › 76. Pay calendars, off-cycle runs and arrears (1.55.0) › 76.2 Pay calendars
sections.text:
Payroll › **Pay calendars**: name, frequency, first day of the first period (weekly and bi-weekly), pay date (days after the period), and the employees – picked one by one or every employee of some categories. An employee is on one calendar only.

- Each period is listed with its pay date; *Run this period* makes a normal payroll run (document number, approval, payslips, WPS file, accounting as usual) with the period's dates.
- The salary structure is prorated to the period; attendance, unpaid leave and overtime are those of the period.
- Loans and advances are deducted once a month – in the last period that ends in the month (marked *Loans and advances*).
- The employees of a calendar are left out of the monthly payroll runs.

sections.section: ZEO Books – update package, version 1.79.5 (20 November 2026) › 76. Pay calendars, off-cycle runs and arrears (1.55.0) › 76.3 Off-cycle runs
sections.text: Payroll › **Off-cycle runs**: a bonus, commission, correction, final settlement, advance, arrears or other payment outside the monthly payroll – lines of employee, component and amount. ZEO makes a payroll run with only those lines (no attendance, loans or advances) that goes through approval and payment as usual.

sections.section: ZEO Books – update package, version 1.79.5 (20 November 2026) › 76. Pay calendars, off-cycle runs and arrears (1.55.0) › 76.4 Arrears
sections.text: Payroll › **Arrears**: a salary change effective from an earlier date. Choose the employees and the date (and optionally the components); *Calculate arrears* compares every payslip since that date with the new salary – per component, with the paid days of each payslip, and only the days from the effective date in its first month. *Save* keeps the lines waiting; they are paid with the employee's next payslip as *Salary arrears* (*Salary arrears recovery* when negative), or at once with an off-cycle run of the kind *Arrears*. Waiting lines can be cancelled.

sections.section: ZEO Books – update package, version 1.79.5 (20 November 2026) › 77. Setup guide (1.56.0)
sections.text: Settings › Administration › **Setup guide** (company administrators). A new company (no employees yet) opens it by itself the first time; an existing company finds it in the menu and is not reminded on Home until the guide is opened.

sections.section: ZEO Books – update package, version 1.79.5 (20 November 2026) › 77. Setup guide (1.56.0) › 77.1 How it works
sections.text:
- 15 steps in four stages: **Company** (1 Start, 2 Company, 3 Branches, 4 Numbering, 5 Organisation), **Time and leave** (6 Time, 7 Shifts, 8 Leave), **Pay and approvals** (9 Payroll, 10 Approvals), **People and go-live** (11 Employees, 12 Users, 13 More modules – optional, 14 Communication, 15 Go live).
- Every step opens with what the company already has and the defaults of the country pack; *Save* keeps the values, *Save and continue* saves, checks and goes to the next step. Close the browser and continue later from the same step.
- *Checked before Next*: items in red block Next (and go-live); items in orange are warnings. Each item has a link to the screen that fixes it.
- *Skip for now* on steps that do not block payroll (numbering, shifts, modules, communication) – the step stays on the checklist.
- Re-running a step adds what is missing and never deletes data. The full screens stay available from each step.

sections.section: ZEO Books – update package, version 1.79.5 (20 November 2026) › 77. Setup guide (1.56.0) › 77.2 New settings and behaviour
sections.text:
| Step | What is new |
|---|---|
| 2 Company | Probation (applied to every branch), notice period (default of a new resignation), contract type (default MOHRE contract type of a new employee), salary days per month (the company pay structure); legal name, licence, TRN on the company profile; WPS employer ID checked (13 digits) |
| 4 Numbering | One pattern for all 28 document types: tokens `{TYPE}` `{BRANCH}` `{LOC}` `{YYYY}` `{YY}` `{MM}` `{SEQ:n}`, counter per company / branch / location, restart every year / month / never; suggested codes (LV, PR, FS, ER …) that can be changed (no two types the same); the employee code pattern (e.g. `E{SEQ:4}`). While the pattern is on it replaces the prefix rows of Document numbering (kept, used again when it is switched off). Numbers already issued are not changed |
| 6 Time | Load the country's holidays and weekend; working hours, break, grace and overtime saved as the company attendance rule; **Eid dates** (moving holidays) confirmed for the year, with a reminder to the administrators 3 weeks before an unconfirmed Eid |
| 6–9 Category view | One row per employee category: weekend calendar, working hours (an attendance rule of the category, copied from the company rule), roster (shift pattern), leave policy and pay structure; *Copy row*, *Apply all*; exceptions listed (employee › category › department › branch › company) |

sections.text: The full release checklist (Part A sections 1–26, Part B every menu entry, Part C user rights with eleven test users) was run on a test company with two branches, 40 employees and six months of data in every app, on a fresh install on an empty database and on the q7 test companies. The results workbook (`ZEO_v1.56.1_Release_Test_Results.xlsx`) lists every check with its evidence. What was found and fixed:

sections.section: ZEO Books – update package, version 1.79.5 (20 November 2026) › 78. Release checklist fixes (1.56.1) › 78.1 Files need sign-in
sections.text:
- Files under `/media/` (employee documents, photos, payslip PDFs, attachments) opened for anyone with the link. They now need a signed-in user: the web app sends a short-lived cookie after sign-in, API clients send their token, the phone app adds a file token to its links. Company logos (`media/logos/`) stay public for the sign-in page. A missing file answers the same as a present one without sign-in (nothing to probe).
- Settings: `ZEO_MEDIA_LOGIN` (default true), `ZEO_MEDIA_ACCEL` (true: nginx sends the file through `X-Accel-Redirect` – the nginx block in `deploy/nginx-zeo.conf`).

sections.section: ZEO Books – update package, version 1.79.5 (20 November 2026) › 78. Release checklist fixes (1.56.1) › 78.2 Rights
sections.text:
| Found | Now |
|---|---|
| A login without the right could create set-up rows that only name a user – approval levels and workflows, notification lists, escalation rules and **user branch access** (its own branch rights) – and HR rows such as overtime, attendance summaries and allocations | refused (403 with the reason) |
| A login without an employee record could raise leave and other requests for any employee | "Your login is not linked to an employee record, so you cannot raise requests." |

| A self-service login exported every employee of its branch (employee Excel / CSV export and reports built on the branch rule) | its own record only |
| Every app role (CRM, Property, HSE …) could list all users of the company | its own login only (Projects roles that hold project rights keep the list to pick members) |
| An app-kit viewer running an action got 400 "not possible now" | 403 "You can only view …" |
| `/organisation/api/schema-data/` answered without sign-in with the branches, departments, designations and categories of any company | sign-in and own companies only |
| A login with no rights and no employee record saw every self-service module in the menu | Home and its profile |

sections.section: ZEO Books – update package, version 1.79.5 (20 November 2026) › 78. Release checklist fixes (1.56.1) › 78.3 Standard approval chains
sections.text: A new company refused late-in / early-out, advance salary, resignation, air ticket and leave requests ("approval workflow is not configured") until someone set up every chain. `setup_zeo`, company creation in the app and a new branch now add a **reporting-manager** chain to every request type that has none; the setup guide step 10 has *Set up the standard chains* and warns how many employees have no reporting manager (their requests are refused until one is set). Existing companies: `python manage.py ensure_approval_chains [--schema <company>] [--dry]`. Existing chains are never changed.

sections.section: ZEO Books – update package, version 1.79.5 (20 November 2026) › 78. Release checklist fixes (1.56.1) › 78.4 Speed of big lists
sections.text: In a company with 1,280 employees the employee list API took 123 s (104 MB, 7,700 queries): it carried every employee's payslips, leave, requests and documents. Above 50 employees the list now leaves those history lists out (they stay on the employee record; `?full=1` keeps them) – 0.8 s. The payslip list read the components of each payslip separately and repeated the run's employee list in every payslip – 92 s → 36 s for 7,519 payslips (the payslip screens should ask for one run; open item). Each page asked 2–4 times for the login's companies and branches (with the notification counts of every branch) while it opened: one request is now shared.

sections.section: ZEO Books – update package, version 1.79.5 (20 November 2026) › 78. Release checklist fixes (1.56.1) › 78.5 Screens
sections.text:
- **HSE forms** (18 registers: documents, occupational health, ergonomics, hygiene …) had the same problem as the app-kit forms before 1.56.0 – labels beside small boxes of 18–24 px: now the same layout and picker.
- **App-kit forms (CRM, Property, Maintenance, Asset Management, People, Masters, Business partners)** – the rest of the form plan of 1.56.0:
  - one picker per record field: type to search and choose in the same box (arrow keys and Enter, opens upwards near the bottom of the form, Escape closes only the list) – it was a search box above a drop-down;
  - placeholders: the field's help text when short, otherwise the format (e-mail, phone, web address, amounts); a "?" icon for fields with a help text (the field help of 1.16 still opens on every field);
  - long forms (more than 10 fields) have a *More details* title after the main fields.
- Escape closes the open pop-up of every screen (it presses the pop-up's Cancel / Close / ×; Material dialogs as before).
- Import: *Check* now applies the same rights as the import – a row of another branch or a request for someone else is listed with the reason instead of "OK".
- Maintenance › Checklists: the checklist lines are text lines (the form showed the product lines of a quotation and asked for products and tax codes).
- A console error "Employee ID parameter is null." on seven pages removed; the extra-fields panel no longer takes a drop-down source for the screen's list (HSE › Training and competency: 400 in the console).

sections.section: ZEO Books – update package, version 1.79.5 (20 November 2026) › 78. Release checklist fixes (1.56.1) › 78.6 Install and other fixes
sections.text:
- A new company made with `setup_zeo` on a fresh database failed in the ZeoMasters data migrations ("current transaction is aborted"): the data steps run in savepoints.
- Re-running `setup_zeo` without `--apps` switched Payroll and other core apps of an existing company off; a re-run now only switches on the apps it names. INSTALL.md shows `--apps hrms,payroll,…`.
- Property: activating a lease or signing a sale without a commission rule looped for ever.
- 500 errors on incomplete saves (missing value, duplicate, wrong link, a date-time in a date field, employee documents / document requests without a type, a payslip without an employee) now answer 400 with the field and the reason.
- An unused branch could not be deleted because of its fiscal year; numbering counters counted before a number was used.
- The air-ticket allocation job logged "Error processing tenant public" on every run.
- A request (e.g. a loan application) of an employee whose user has the phone app could not be saved: the push check of the in-app notice read the company's push settings in the shared schema and the failed read broke the save. The settings are read in the company, in a savepoint.

sections.section: ZEO Books – update package, version 1.79.5 (20 November 2026) › 79. Careers page and talent pools (1.57.0) › 79.1 Careers page
sections.text:
- Every company can publish a **careers page** at `https://<web app>/careers/<company>` (the company is its database name). Recruitment › **Careers page** switches it on and holds its texts: page title, headline, introduction, *about the company*, brand colour, whether salary ranges show. The company logo is shown from the company record.
- The page lists the job openings that are **published or interviewing**, have the channel **Careers page** and whose closing date has not passed – with search and filters for department, location and type. It works on a phone and in Arabic (language box on the page; the texts the company types stay as typed).
- **Apply form:** name, e-mail, mobile, nationality, location, visa status, experience, notice period, expected salary, LinkedIn, cover letter, CV (PDF / Word, up to 5 MB; required unless switched off), the job's questions, the privacy text (must be ticked) and an optional *keep my CV for N months and tell me about other jobs* consent.
- An application creates (or updates – the same e-mail is one candidate; an earlier CV is kept as a candidate document) the candidate and an application at stage *Applied* with its source. The hiring manager of the job is told in ZEO; the addresses in *Tell these addresses* get an e-mail; the candidate gets an acknowledgement (can be switched off). The same person cannot apply twice for one job.
- **Send us your CV:** without a job the candidate goes to the talent pool *General applications* (made the first time; it cannot be deleted).
- **Where they came from:** add `?src=linkedin` (or `indeed`, `bayt`, `naukrigulf`) to the link you post; re-engage e-mails add `?src=pool`. The application shows it (*From*).
- Protection: a hidden field stops form robots; 8 applications an hour from one address and

sections.text:
- Recruitment › **Talent pools**: pools with tags and an owner; the members with their status (active, contacted, interested, not interested, applied again, hired), tags, experience and whether they may be contacted.
- Candidates get **tags** and *may contact until* (set from the consent on the careers page: today + the months in the settings). Candidates › *Add to talent pool*; Job openings › *Add to a talent pool* (the rejected / withdrawn or everyone not hired of that job); the pool's *+ Add*.
- **Re-engage** (on a pool): a subject, a message and optionally an open job – an e-mail to each member who agreed that the CV is kept (consent not run out), is not *not interested* / *hired* and has not applied for that job yet; the others are listed as left out with the reason. The e-mails sent are kept on the pool (*E-mails sent*). Applying from the link marks the member *applied again*.
- Job openings › **Matching candidates**: earlier candidates who may be contacted and whose tags / skills match the title and the requirements.
- Rights: the talent pool screens follow the rights of the new models (talentpool, talentpoolmember); groups that had rights on candidates got the same rights on talent pools by the migration. The careers page settings need the job opening rights.

sections.section: ZEO Books – update package, version 1.79.5 (20 November 2026) › 80. Concurrent assignments and matrix reporting (1.58.0) › 80.1 Assignments and secondments
sections.text:
- HR operations › **Assignments and secondments**: a second place where an employee works at the same time as the main job – **secondment** (another branch or department), **second role**, **project assignment** or **acting role** – with the branch, department, role, project, the **manager on this assignment**, the **share of time %**, start and end dates and a reason.
- The rest of the time is the main job of the employee record (e.g. a 40 % secondment leaves 60 % main job). The total of the assignments of one employee on any day may not pass 100 % – the message names the assignments already there; the same place twice for the same dates is refused; the employee cannot be their own manager.
- Status: *planned* before the start date, *active*, *ended* after the end date (the daily HR operations job moves them), *cancelled*. Actions: **End the assignment** (last day) and **Cancel** (planned only). Ended and cancelled assignments cannot be changed.
- New app-kit forms now start with the model defaults (a checkbox that defaults to on is ticked, a choice shows its default) – every app on the app kit (CRM, Property, Maintenance, Assets, People, HR operations).

sections.section: ZEO Books – update package, version 1.79.5 (20 November 2026) › 80. Concurrent assignments and matrix reporting (1.58.0) › 80.2 Functional (dotted-line) managers
sections.text:
- HR operations › **Functional managers**: one functional manager per employee besides the reporting manager, with *for* (area), the **weight in the appraisal %** (0–50) and optional dates. The reporting manager cannot be the functional manager too.
- **Approvals:** a new approver role **Functional (dotted-line) manager** in Leave policies › Approvers (each level of a leave chain) and in the expense policies (approval levels). Who answers: the functional manager; else the manager of the employee's largest active assignment that has *this manager approves as functional manager*; else the reporting manager – a request is never stuck on that level. Tested end to end: a leave chain *reporting manager → functional manager* goes to the reporting manager, then to the functional manager.
- **My team › Dotted line:** the people for whom you are the functional manager or the manager of an active assignment (not your direct reports), with the relation.
- **Org chart:** a dashed note with the functional manager (and area) and a line per active assignment on the person's card.

sections.section: ZEO Books – update package, version 1.79.5 (20 November 2026) › 80. Concurrent assignments and matrix reporting (1.58.0) › 80.3 Functional input in appraisals
sections.text:
- For every goal sheet of an active appraisal cycle whose employee has a functional manager, a **functional review** is opened (daily, and when the functional manager is set). The functional manager finds it under HR operations › **Functional reviews** and uses **Give my input**: a rating 1–5, strengths, to improve.
- The reporting manager sees the input in Performance › Manager review (*Functional manager input*) and a **blended score** = manager score × (100 % – weight) + functional rating × weight. The reporting manager stays the final reviewer. The employee does not see the functional input.

sections.section: ZEO Books – update package, version 1.79.5 (20 November 2026) › 80. Concurrent assignments and matrix reporting (1.58.0) › 80.4 Cost split and reports
sections.text:
- **Payroll cost allocation** (1.50.0): when an employee has no cost rule of their own for the month, the assignments with *split the salary cost* take their share of the gross pay – to the project of a project assignment, otherwise to the department – by the days each was active in the month; the rest stays on the employee's own cost centre or department. A cost rule of the employee always wins.
- HR operations › **Assignments and matrix**: active / planned / ending figures; *who works where* (each employee on assignments, the share bar of the main job and the assignments); **full-time equivalents by department** (the main job counts with its share, an assignment counts in its department); assignments ending in the next 30 days; the functional managers.
- Rights: HR sees the assignments of the employees of their branches and the assignments hosted by their branches; the employee sees their own; the manager of an assignment sees it; the report is for HR.

sections.section: ZEO Books – update package, version 1.79.5 (20 November 2026) › 81. Legal rules by date (1.59.0)
sections.text: Laws and contribution rates change on a set date. Until 1.59.0 a rate was changed in place, so re-running an earlier month or settling an end of service after a change used the new figure for the old period. From 1.59.0 the new figures are added **from a date** and the old ones stay for the earlier dates.

sections.section: ZEO Books – update package, version 1.79.5 (20 November 2026) › 81. Legal rules by date (1.59.0) › 81.1 Which day decides
sections.text:
- **Payroll run:** the 1st of the pay month – also when the payroll period starts on the 26th of the month before. A re-run of an earlier month keeps that month's rules.
- **End of service (settlement):** the last working day.
- **Month-end provisions and the gratuity report:** their date (month end / "as of").
- **Anything else** (screens, previews without a date): today.

sections.section: ZEO Books – update package, version 1.79.5 (20 November 2026) › 81. Legal rules by date (1.59.0) › 81.2 Statutory schemes – rates by date
sections.text:
- Payroll › Setup › Statutory schemes › **Rates by date** on each scheme: the rates on the scheme itself (from its effective date) and the dated versions, with *in force today* and *coming*.
- **New rates from a date**: the employee and employer % (or fixed amounts, or the slabs / tax figures), minimum base, ceiling, *only when gross ≤*, the law reference and notes. The form starts from the rates in force. The new rates must start after the scheme's own date; one set per date; rates between 0 and 100 %; the ceiling not below the minimum. When payroll runs of that month or later exist already the message says so – their payslips keep the old figures until they are re-run.
- **Check an employee** has a *Rates on* date and shows from which date the rates come.
- API: `statutory/<id>/versions/` (GET / POST / DELETE ?version=), `statutory/in-force/?date=`, `statutory/preview/?employee=&date=`.

sections.section: ZEO Books – update package, version 1.79.5 (20 November 2026) › 81. Legal rules by date (1.59.0) › 81.3 Legal rates
sections.text:
- Payroll › Setup › **Legal rates**: the legal figures ZEO uses in its own calculations – GPSSA employee rate (joined on / after 31 Oct 2023), GPSSA employee rate (joined before), GPSSA employer rate, the minimum and maximum contribution salary – with the value in force on the *Rules on* date, the built-in value and the history. **New value from a date** with the law reference. Rates are fractions (0.11 = 11 %). Without a value the built-in figure applies (the same figures as before 1.59.0).
- The payroll GPSSA variables (`pension_salary`, `pension_employee_rate`, `pension_employer_rate`) use the values in force on the 1st of the pay month.

sections.section: ZEO Books – update package, version 1.79.5 (20 November 2026) › 81. Legal rules by date (1.59.0) › 81.4 Gratuity law changes (country policies)
sections.text:
- Organisation › Country policies › **Law changes by date** › **+ Gratuity change from a date**: the gratuity slabs (days a year per service band), the minimum service and the cap, from a date, with the law reference. The form starts from the policy's rules. The new rules replace the policy's gratuity rules as a whole from that date.
- For the UAE: while no dated change is in force the gratuity is worked out exactly as before; from the date of a change the slabs and cap of the change apply, with the same daily wage as before (basic ÷ 30 at the end of service and in the payroll accrual) unless the change sets its own daily basis.
- Annual leave and overtime are **not** versioned here: the leave and overtime calculations run from Leave policies and the overtime setup, so a change there is made in those screens.
- A company with its own gratuity table (Organisation › Gratuity) keeps using that table – the table wins over the country rules, as before.
- API: `country-policies/<id>/versions/` (GET / POST / DELETE ?version=), `country-policies/in-force/?branch=&date=`.

sections.section: ZEO Books – update package, version 1.79.5 (20 November 2026) › 81. Legal rules by date (1.59.0) › 81.5 Rights
sections.text:
- Statutory rates and legal rates: seen by the users with payroll setup or payroll run rights, changed by those who may change salary components or the payroll settings (as the schemes themselves).
- Country policy versions: changed by those who may change country or leave policies.
